Peter,
Picture this: morning light filtering through a cathedral of redwoods, the air cool and rich with the earthy scent of the forest. A chorus of birdsong echoes through the canopy, while the forest floor teems with life—ferns unfurling, deer stepping softly, and the Russian River flowing in the distance.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109480534/551244100/2018652235?contactdata=cakKjePfTWvpYQgBjCX8hp1/uG2cSOxBXt6BaFIScmomMQFtaeeN1F6nf7xa8YjbG+1b4eOODI6WNzwMqhAeCILGnCxNgnFx3aeNerQNDXPMoF8tzjOkxMUF9DLMVh0CJDzLh+UAev0VPnpohOifwLCLQ9dM4SYfwOE8gj7SkCI=&ms=MonteRio8_Image1&sourceid=1166936&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImEwYmY3NmEwLWU5NDctZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=eio0eTaw-257hguuup7RsN1HiWUp6M4Rc9C2H6iwGJA=&emci=9bd7b399-e947-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=a0bf76a0-e947-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=1504551)
_Photo by Max Whittaker_
This isn’t just a beautiful place. It’s a living, breathing ecosystem, and a vital link in California’s redwood network. [**Monte Rio Redwoods connects a fragmented forest, creating a sanctuary for wildlife and a refuge for people seeking peace, wonder and connection to the natural world.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109480536/551244102/2018652235?contactdata=cakKjePfTWvpYQgBjCX8hp1/uG2cSOxBXt6BaFIScmomMQFtaeeN1F6nf7xa8YjbG+1b4eOODI6WNzwMqhAeCILGnCxNgnFx3aeNerQNDXPMoF8tzjOkxMUF9DLMVh0CJDzLh+UAev0VPnpohOifwLCLQ9dM4SYfwOE8gj7SkCI=&ms=MonteRio8_Link1&sourceid=1166936&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImEwYmY3NmEwLWU5NDctZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=eio0eTaw-257hguuup7RsN1HiWUp6M4Rc9C2H6iwGJA=&emci=9bd7b399-e947-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=a0bf76a0-e947-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=1504551)
I could go down a list of reasons why we must preserve Monte Rio Redwoods. **At its core, the reason we must preserve Monte Rio Redwoods is simple:** Because it’s our duty as human beings to...
* safeguard the delicate balance of ecosystems that provide clean air, clean water, and a home for endangered species.
* stand up for [**forests that cannot advocate for themselves.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109480537/551244103/2018652235?contactdata=cakKjePfTWvpYQgBjCX8hp1/uG2cSOxBXt6BaFIScmomMQFtaeeN1F6nf7xa8YjbG+1b4eOODI6WNzwMqhAeCILGnCxNgnFx3aeNerQNDXPMoF8tzjOkxMUF9DLMVh0CJDzLh+UAev0VPnpohOifwLCLQ9dM4SYfwOE8gj7SkCI=&ms=MonteRio8_Link2&sourceid=1166936&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImEwYmY3NmEwLWU5NDctZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=eio0eTaw-257hguuup7RsN1HiWUp6M4Rc9C2H6iwGJA=&emci=9bd7b399-e947-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=a0bf76a0-e947-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=1504551)
* ensure that the beauty, peace, and wonder of places like Monte Rio Redwoods are not lost, but passed on to future generations.
* conserve this special place.

clean_body: Help secure this breathtaking forest and have your gift matched! Peter, Picture this: morning light filtering through a cathedral of redwoods, the air cool and rich with the earthy scent of the forest. A chorus of birdsong echoes through the canopy, while the forest floor teems with life—ferns unfurling, deer stepping softly, and the Russian River flowing in the distance. Photo by Max Whittaker This isn’t just a beautiful place. It’s a living, breathing ecosystem, and a vital link in California’s redwood network. I could go down a list of reasons why we must preserve Monte Rio Redwoods. At its core, the reason we must preserve Monte Rio Redwoods is simple: Because it’s our duty as human beings to... safeguard the delicate balance of ecosystems that provide clean air, clean water, and a home for endangered species. stand up for ensure that the beauty, peace, and wonder of places like Monte Rio Redwoods are not lost, but passed on to future generations. conserve this special place. , and your opportunity to make twice the impact thanks to the Visser Family. In honor of J. Hugh and Eleanor Visser, they will match every donation up to $100,000. Together, we will ensure Monte Rio Redwoods is secured—not just for us, but for every generation that follows. Thank you for being someone who shows up when it matters most. With gratitude, | Sara Press Senior Manager of Land Protection ---|--- | | | | ---|---|---|--- Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States |

subject: We’re built for this moment / Nosotros estamos construidos para este momento
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Working with allies to elect San Antonio's next mayor
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20San%20Antonio%20members%20and%20Gina%20Ortiz%20Jones.jpg]
COMMUNITY WIN: San Antonio voters elected Gina Ortiz Jones [https://www.texastribune.org/2025/06/07/san-antonio-mayor-gina-ortiz-jones/] in Saturday's mayoral runoff, making clear they are hungry for people-powered leadership at City Hall. They also said no to Gov. Greg Abbott and his big dollar PACs that pumped fear-mongering into this race. Right-wing groups spent over $2.1 million dollars to prop up their candidate, who was ultimately defeated. [https://www.sacurrent.com/news/gina-ortiz-jones-wins-san-antonio-mayoral-race-despite-being-outspent-by-conservative-rival-37687786] This once again shows how at the end of the day, it’s meaningful door-to-door conversations with voters that wins elections.
In the span of three weeks, TOP PAC's voter engagement program worked in conjunctioICn with a roster of community and labor allies to make over 28,000 door knocks across San Antonio — reaching out to predominantly Black and Latino voters who too often are ignored by traditional political campaigns. This election win would not have been possible without the hard work of our partners ACT4SA Action PAC, AFSCME San Antonio Local 2021, UNITE HERE Local 23, Planned Parenthood Texas Votes, San Antonio Alliance, LIUNA Local 1095, and Texas Majority PAC.
Understanding how much is on the line for San Antonians this election — from protecting our rights, to improving neighborhood infrastructure, to making housing and childcare more affordable — TOP PAC is in the streets of working Black and Latino neighborhoods pushing for the political and policy shifts our communities deserve.
We’re excited about Gina Ortiz Jones’s election, and look forward to further strengthening our working relationship with her to address the priorities of working-class San Antonio families.
Resisting the MAGA regime mass deportation machine
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/LA%20protest.png]
All eyes are on Los Angeles [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-administration-mobilizing-2000-more-national-guard-troops-for-los-angeles-protests/] . TOP is in utmost solidarity with those who are peacefully protesting against and personally impacted by ICE's latest round of ruthless attacks on migrant families.
The tip of Trump's mass deportation spear, ICE is using increasingly aggressive tactics to detain people, cruelly trapping people arriving at court appointments and denying them due process. This isn't in error; it's all by design -- and it's white nationalism in action. Agents with the rogue agency are abducting people and violating their rights to meet their rising quotas.
The resistance against this assault on our communities has spread across the country, and momentum is building in Texas, as our MAGA puppet governor Greg Abbott has deployed the Texas National Guard to San Antonio [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/jun/11/texas-protests-national-guard-san-antonio] , all in an attempt to silence protesters.
This military escalation is about spreading fear and asserting control, not establishing safety. Instead of protecting communities, Trump and MAGA want to provoke communities.
TOP will continue to call out and peacefully resist Trump's mass deportation machine, with the full intention of fighting authoritarianism, and protecting immigrant families as well as fellow community members.
NO MAGA BUDGET CUTS:
Back in D.C. with allies to demand the housing and healthcare we ALL deserve
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20members%20DC%20healthcare%20housing%20protest.jpg]
Trump's 'one big beautiful bill' that Republicans on Capitol Hill are ramming through the legislative process is one big mess and a betrayal to working families. Instead of adequately funding our federal government to better serve our everyday needs, the bill is a huge MAGA tax break for billionaires and slashes essential programs that serve MILLIONS across the country.
TOP members from Houston, San Antonio, and Dallas were back in Washington D.C. this week , ramping up pressure on elected officials with our partners at Popular Democracy in Action to call out the drastic cuts to Medicaid and federal housing assistance in Trump's budget proposal.
WATCH video of our rally in D.C. here. [https://www.facebook.com/watch/live/?mibextid=wwXIfr&ref=watch_permalink&v=694419526727067&rdid=DQhrJlgW4DF5FiJB]
These massive budget cuts will be disastrous for working families already struggling to make ends meet, if implemented. Along with national allies, TOP will keep fighting and hold accountable MAGA Republicans who support this ridiculous billionaire handout.
TOP Tip: Stay informed about COVID as cases rise
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Peoples%20CDC%20logo.png]
COVID cases are on the rise again [https://www.today.com/health/coronavirus/new-covid-variant-nb181-symptoms-rcna208189] , with a new variant spreading across the country this summer. The People's CDC is a non-corporate coalition of public health practitioners, scientists, healthcare workers, educators, advocates and people from all walks of life working to reduce the harmful impacts of COVID-19. Visit their website to for up-to-date info and resources on how you and your loved ones can stay safe from COVID. [https://peoplescdc.org/]
Español
Trabajando con aliados para elegir al próximo alcalde de San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20San%20Antonio%20members%20and%20Gina%20Ortiz%20Jones.jpg]
VICTORIA COMUNITARIA: ¡Los votantes de San Antonio eligieron a Gina Ortiz Jones [https://www.texastribune.org/2025/06/07/san-antonio-mayor-gina-ortiz-jones/] en la segunda vuelta de las elecciones para la alcaldía este sábado, dejando claro que quieren un liderazgo impulsado por el poder del pueblo en el Ayuntamiento! También le dijeron NO al gobernador Greg Abbott y a sus PACs millonarios que llenaron esta contienda de mensajes alarmistas. Los grupos de derecha gastaron más de $2.1 millones de dólares para respaldar a su candidato, quien al final fue derrotado. [https://www.sacurrent.com/news/gina-ortiz-jones-wins-san-antonio-mayoral-race-despite-being-outspent-by-conservative-rival-37687786] Una vez más, queda claro que las conversaciones cara a cara con los votantes son las que realmente ganan elecciones.
En tan solo tres semanas, el programa de participación electoral de TOP PAC trabajó junto a una lista de aliados comunitarios y sindicales para tocar más de 28,000 puertas en San Antonio — llegando principalmente a votantes morenos y latinos que muy a menudo son ignorados por las campañas políticas tradicionales. Esta victoria no habría sido posible sin el trabajo incansable de nuestros compañeros en ACT4SA Action PAC, AFSCME San Antonio Local 2021, UNITE HERE Local 23, Planned Parenthood Texas Votes, San Antonio Alliance, LIUNA Local 1095 y Texas Majority PAC.
Sabemos lo mucho que está en juego para San Antonio en estas elecciones — desde proteger nuestros derechos, hasta mejorar la infraestructura en los vecindarios y hacer más accesibles la vivienda y el cuidado infantil — por eso TOP PAC está presente en las calles de comunidades morenas y latinas trabajadoras, impulsando los cambios políticos y de políticas públicas que nuestras comunidades merecen.
Nos entusiasma la elección de Gina Ortiz Jones y esperamos fortalecer aún más nuestra relación de trabajo con ella para atender las prioridades de las familias trabajadoras de San Antonio.
Resistiendo la máquina de deportaciones masivas del régimen MAGA
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/LA%20protest.png]
Todas las miradas están puestas en Los Ángeles. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-administration-mobilizing-2000-more-national-guard-troops-for-los-angeles-protests/] TOP está en total solidaridad con quienes protestan pacíficamente y con quienes han sido directamente afectados por la última ola de ataques despiadados del ICE contra familias migrantes.
Como punta de lanza de las deportaciones masivas impulsadas por Trump, ICE está utilizando tácticas cada vez más agresivas para detener personas, atrapando cruelmente a quienes se presentan a citas judiciales y negándoles el debido proceso. Esto no es un error; todo está diseñado así es nacionalismo blanco en acción. Agentes de esta agencia fuera de control están secuestrando personas y violando sus derechos para cumplir con sus crecientes cuotas.
La resistencia frente a este ataque contra nuestras comunidades se ha extendido por todo el país, y en Texas está cobrando fuerza, ya que nuestro gobernador títere del MAGA, Greg Abbott, ha desplegado la Guardia Nacional de Texas en San Antonio [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/jun/11/texas-protests-national-guard-san-antonio] con el objetivo de silenciar a las personas manifestándose.

There are additional waves of attack underway. This is likely as a result of five rounds of US-Iran talks which have not been successful with a sixth-round originally scheduled for Sunday.
Clearly, Israel's actions demonstrate that they had no belief that these negotiations would be successful and they had no choice but to stop this radical Iranian regime to have nuclear weapons.
This comes off the heels of a scathing report that the International Atomic Energy Agency issued that Iran was concealing and hiding its program to enrich uranium into weapons grade material. They declared that Iran was not complying with its nuclear nonproliferation obligations,. **This negative resolution by the UN watchdog agency was the first one in 20 years. Tehran responded by condemning this resolution.**
**US Not Involved In Attack**
The US was not part of this unilateral attack which has put some distance between the US and Israel and Secretary of State Marco Rubio distanced the US from this attack in his statement:
U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio also issued a statement:
"Tonight, Israel took unilateral action against Iran. We are not involved in strikes against Iran and our top priority is protecting American forces in the region. Israel advised us that they believe this action was necessary for its self-defense. President Trump and the Administration have taken all necessary steps to protect our forces and remain in close contact with our regional partners. Let me be clear: Iran should not target U.S. interests or personnel."
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu - expressed the "clear and present danger" by the Terrorists of Tehran to Israel's very survival and will not allow Israel to be a victim of a "nuclear holocaust perpetuated by the Iranian Regime" .
Currently, the Trump Administration has indicated that the US would not participate in the attacks, but the US has historically come to Israel's defense from attacks by Iran. President Trump has warned Iran not to take action against the US.
**Israel is in a State of Emergency with only "necessary" activities.**
This is a direct attack to Iran who has been funding and arming proxy wars against Israel and Israel is finally focusing on cutting off the head of the snake.
**Netanyahu Issues Message to Iranian People of a Bright Future**
Netanyahu also included a special message to the Iranian people to tell them that this fight is not with Iranians but with the the brutal dictatorship that has become more radical. He also stated that "the day of the liberation is near" for the Iranians to be free from this regime and that the "ancient friendship" between Iranians and Israelis will thrive once again.
**Key Democrats Weigh In Showing a Divide in the Party**
As this pre-emptive strike continues and the US is being careful at this time, a split is forming in the Democrat party on Israel

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8680%2E5257348%2EZCxRWQ ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek, by now,
you have probably seen the pictures and videos of my fellow Senator from
California and friend Alex Padilla getting forcefully removed from and
handcuffed at a DHS press conference.

The actions of Kristi Noem’s security detail were shocking and
disgraceful.

I watched this video with horror, seeing agents grab Alex Padilla, pushing
him out of the public press conference after he had identified himself as
a U.S. Senator, dragging him into a hallway, bringing him down to the
ground, putting his arms behind his back, and placing him in handcuffs.

I am shocked by how far we have descended in just the first 140 days of
this administration.

We have a president calling on the National Guard over the objection of a
governor to try to intimidate and interfere with law enforcement in
California. A president calling in the Marines to try to inflame tensions
in our city. And now this latest act, when a U.S. Senator goes to demand
questions about the lawfulness or lawlessness of these actions, to see him
brought to the ground and handcuffed.

What is becoming of our democracy? Are there no limits to what this
administration will do?

Derek, all Alex
was trying to do was ask a question and do his job of oversight. He’s
demanding accountability and transparency into the actions of the
Department of Homeland Security. He has every right to do so.

That the administration’s response was to forcefully remove him points to
the very dangerous path our country is heading down.

Alex Padilla is one of the most decent people I know. One of the most
dedicated public servants I know, and someone of the greatest character.
He embodies public service. He comes from very humble origins, and he has
never forgotten those roots. And the beauty of this country is that you
can come from a very humble origin, and you could end up here.

So while Alex and I continue to demand accountability from this
administration and fight for Californians, [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-padilla.0zFPlo&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_RES_AC90_20250612_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=8680%2E5257348%2EZCxRWQ ]please pitch in to our

body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. subject: Stay tuned!
body:

---
Peter, We greatly appreciate everyone that turned out to vote during the primary election either by mail-in-ballot, voting early in-person or on election day at the polls. Now it’s time to turn our attention to November! As common sense voters, it is important that we continue to hold their feet to the fire and ensure that candidates up and down the ballot always strive to earn your vote. Let’s make certain they are talking about common sense issues that matter to voters and not continuing more of the same! Stay tuned to hear more from us. For New Jersey, Elizabeth Nader

This message is part of an ongoing conversation between us, and I want to take a moment to ensure you have full transparency about why you received this message, how your information is handled, and what to expect from future emails. Why You’re Receiving This Email You’re receiving this email because at some point, you opted in to receive updates, news, or information on a specific topic we’ve previously discussed or shared. Whether it was through a subscription, a form submission, or another form of communication, your information was shared willingly, and we respect your decision to connect with us. If you’re wondering about the nature of our correspondence, rest assured that we aim to keep all emails relevant, timely, and free from unnecessary clutter. This includes respecting your inbox and refraining from sending irrelevant messages. Your Privacy is Important We value your trust and take your privacy very seriously. The information you provide is securely stored and never shared, sold, or used outside the purpose for which you provided it. If you ever want to review how we handle your data, feel free to contact us directly. Transparency is our priority, and we’re happy to address any questions you might have. You are always in control of the information you share. If you feel that any part of your subscription or interaction needs clarification, let us know. We’re here to provide accurate answers and ensure your satisfaction. How to Unsubscribe or Manage Your Preferences We understand that everyone’s inbox is different. If you ever find our emails no longer relevant, there’s no hard feelings. You can easily manage your email preferences or unsubscribe using the link provided below. By clicking the unsubscribe link, you’ll be taken to a page where you can either adjust your communication preferences (such as receiving fewer emails or only on specific topics) or completely remove yourself from our list. The process is straightforward, and any changes will take effect promptly. We don’t use tricks or gimmicks to keep you subscribed. Our priority is to ensure that our emails add value to your day, and if they don’t, we respect your decision to part ways. Accessibility and Communication If you have any trouble accessing the unsubscribe page, managing preferences, or understanding why you’re receiving this email, you can reach out directly to our support team at info@commonsenseclub.org. We aim to provide a response within a reasonable time frame and address your concerns effectively. Our communication is designed to be as inclusive as possible, but we know there’s always room for improvement. If you have any feedback on how we can make our emails more accessible or relevant, please don’t hesitate to share. A Commitment to Non-Intrusive Emails We aim to create a non-intrusive communication experience. This means we won’t overwhelm your inbox with excessive messages, and we work hard to ensure our content remains clear and concise. The purpose of this email is to stay connected with you and provide updates or information that we believe is meaningful. If we ever fail to meet these standards, we encourage you to let us know. Feedback, whether positive or constructive, is always appreciated. Your thoughts help us understand how we can do better and improve our communication approach. While we cannot guarantee every suggestion will be implemented, we will take the time to carefully review and consider your input. Contact Information If you’d like to get in touch with us outside of managing your preferences, here’s how you can reach us: Email: info@commonsenseclub.org

Mailing Address:
Common Sense Club
165 Route 35
Red Bank, New Jersey, 07701 We strive to ensure all communication channels are open and readily available to you. Whether it’s a question, comment, or concern, our team is ready to assist. Legal Information We comply with all applicable laws and regulations regarding email communication. This includes adhering to anti-spam laws and maintaining the highest standards for consent-based communication. Your trust matters, and we work diligently to ensure every email you receive meets these requirements. If you need further clarification on our compliance policies or legal obligations, please feel free to ask. Transparency and accountability are central to our communication strategy, and we’re happy to provide additional details if needed. A Final Note Emails are one of the many ways we stay connected, but we understand they aren’t perfect for everyone. If there’s another way you’d prefer to communicate or stay updated, let us know. Whether it’s through social media, a direct call, or another channel, we’re open to finding the most effective way to share information with you. We want to emphasize that our goal is never to disrupt or clutter your inbox. Every email sent is intended to provide value, and we genuinely appreciate your time and attention. Thank you for allowing us to stay in touch with you. This footer was designed to ensure transparency, provide essential information, and give you full control over your communication preferences. We hope it meets your expectations, but if there’s anything you’d like to see improved, we’re always here to listen.

## Air India Jet Crashes, 241 Dead
A London-bound Air India Boeing 787 [crashed into a residential area of Ahmedabad, India](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1urDAUhJ8GOiP_YUPh4jbb7W1TogM-LCcxNrId0L59RF4h1Ugz0mjm-3hOT6BA8fUfdnR1TVPEqwSsFfNEJQOGUjN9YaEMMQTYAWKdJJc944YJNXmg8J50692KKFG16ITV48BHYWy7uQH94jmOfB76AVetvBoW4NYYNFYOsiV3t3EjlODccNGNZgY9as9BWTTgG83RU025-0wU64ZreKcTc7ekvQ1uq_UojfrXyEcjH9d1dXFe7hd3fjspB9_IBxSCWygzip6AHQEiMiBhBVsylA0Lg21HDzN4Niek-GJSS1a-80lnyoXlJYIUstd9m50_LgqBirGN5q8dKPwuqn_CeDr5EwAA____14dx), shortly after takeoff on Thursday, killing 241 of the 242 people aboard. [The lone survivor](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u2zAMhZ9G3hjItCzXg4cu2m7XjgYTMTF7acmQlAR5-8J9hS5nOcB3fn5_rV8kKunxi3Ze2j2vid9VuTUuq9RCrLUV-eYqhZIq7USprWhxBOuhH9ZIop_VdXG5MyMPHS_95OYfdu791G2LHSL2NLrbNd5H7-aZHA3j1SES4jiNnSwnzfp-6K31tr_M_kpudtHSMLGnaJzlKC2Xy58sqW18109-cbnc8t7psrV2VDP8NBgMhvQ5cm2nZTCcYIPBeoOhR4PhnYtGOCcaDAfVyunBBeqzvOTFFUgKSIpCcCglhluhukHbqMG3qHKEMxjQWjg4H8rQNi4M71OuOcrJUAUq-Zki7GwwdGWJx1tUpfrJOPvYSfRf9_Zfh78W_BsAAP__D3SVfw), a British national, was thrown from the wreckage and is hospitalized. The plane struck a medical hostel, killing and injuring dozens on the ground, including students. Watch [footage of the crash here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1qwzAUxfGnkbcYfThSNGgoFBMoKRQKHc21dRWrleUg3cTk7Yv7Cl3Pgd_w_7oMF4gp5us7LOgorEPGrSYkwjLEWgBTpRJ_sMYCOSVYADINksvjgeuDUIOHmJ5D13gXECWqBp0wnT1xK7RpZjedwuQFHq0Vp2CNMQG1Cd6r0Wph5dhEt2tcCyU411y0Vo_Q2c5zUAY1eNZx9JHW0n6vMdOMIT3XB5Z2WpcmuZnoVpl6YbJnst-2rX2ud7qPuP_7AjTNTPUPpl5z6T_fzvnM-UdTnL9tMaVYtWEdvy4Q0x9J_-rwcPI3AAD__5B0cXE). (Warning: Distressing) It’s the deadliest crash in India in decades and the first involving a Dreamliner. Investigators are now searching for the black boxes to [determine the cause](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DtuwzAQBNDTUJ0F_kRaBYs06pw2pbAmV_YmK9EgCcu-faBcId0AAzxg5usyX4CYttsnrBjakucN98rYGpaZagHk2gr9YKUCGzOsAFubtdTDSbqTMnMC4vdsuxQWRI2mw6C8Hc9yVM539-BxiF5qMFaBUqM7L-dkxziYBWIaBt9RODTplFFSOqn60V3BjjZJMB4dJGElJmq59N-ZtnbHhd_5iaWPee043Ft7VGE-hJ6EnvZ976_XeHRCT8cYoScojSLjEaPT7q20Kq9X7kpIj52YqTovrLytQPyntn9d8Qz6NwAA__9aX3H8), with early attention on a rare double engine failure, flap configuration error, or bird strike during takeoff.
## Israel Launches Iran Airstrikes
Israel launched a [major airstrike on Iran early Friday local time](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1yqzAQB_DTQCdGEkIyhYrX0Pm1KZkFLfYmi-SRFDO-fQZPbpD2vx-zv_24zlcgpnj7Dzv6uqU54lEYa8U8U8mAXGqmLyyUITLDDhDrrKUehLRC9XMA4tds2uA3RI19i145M17kqKxr734YLhc7rGZ0m7HrGAJsQSkzDHYZg1O2JX9uk1b1SkorVTfaBcxogoTeoYXQGImBasrdZ6JY77jxKz0xd2vaW_b3Wh-l6f81emr0dBxHF5f1VJz1M0mZQ6OnE9DoiemJYuF0O6M3UPwKxdkhdgqBUSCUKtYUN6a1ivfQ9yNAxSLyGkEr7bRrsw-Pg5ipWNcYeduB-H1W_dMvn17_BAAA___q7Yor) under “Operation Rising Lion,” targeting nuclear and military sites in and around Tehran. Israel’s Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated the [operation aimed to dismantle Iran's nuclear capabilities](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uwzAMhU9jbw6oH8vRoKFLtnTtaNAWE7OlLUMSkub2hdsjdCQ-gO997-M6XpGFt_s7rhTqLY0bPYtQrZRHLhlJSs38RYUzbiK4Im511KD7DlynzBiR5TXaNoYbkSbTUlCD9Wfwyg3tEpSzdopIanZTryz2ZtAzEIH3zqBxLYfjGzhlFIADdfJuQuttBDQDOYyNBYpcUz59Jt7qQjd5pQfl05zWVsJS614a89boS6MvuB8CBzqOXHkWavTlaN_R9y6pcNpK96fWVVoOAKCNRXDUK33GM840WXCTsqD9oL1vc4j7k0W4uKGxcF-R5Te-_muzR9A_AQAA__8ztn60), citing intelligence that Iran had enriched uranium sufficient for multiple nuclear weapons. The United States has denied involvement in the operation, with [Secretary of State Marco Rubio emphasizing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZCC72xgcOBjpRDaXXogau5nxrYEZbA3i71fsL2xcqlK99-8-3immuD7-0sKuzNu48pETl8L7GPNOnHLZ4xfnuNOaEi1EaxlBQltLUyscA8V0jroKbmYGxoqd6rTtpVWmq57Om7Ynb4PqjScz92GSHrRWCN5ra1QV3bUmjUIlpZGqsWYibXWQhB0bCkJLDrFse_N_i2t58pzO7cN747elSu5ZyisLvAkYBAzHcTTT5K9MwHDBCBhS_LCAwVs8A7_Pd6eKwOG15SLwD-XMRUCLN_BBaiRd28mHWsuZ6l5aqjulsLV2YoVKAF69anfhdcSUYjad0PKxUEw_h8qvLH4cfAcAAP__GUaCjQ) that Israel acted unilaterally and that the U.S. priority is protecting American forces in the region. In response to the attack, Israel has declared a state of emergency, anticipating potential missile and drone retaliation from Iran.
## RFK Assassination Files Declassified
The CIA released 1,450 pages Thursday [related to Robert F. Kennedy’s 1968 assassination](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGP4yAUhH8N7mw9MMGmoLjGXa690noxj-RdMETAxsq_X3n_wnYjzWhG8_27rlfkyOn-F3dyLeQ10VEjtUZl5VqQYm2Fn1S5YIoRd8TUVgXq0oPp5bh65PhZdeddIFI0duTkpO0MVpqpezgw07RpQxhQkkULN-uNmueL1whyho7d2QZGjhLAgBysuaG22gOOExn0QgN5brkM_zOn9qAQP_lNZdjy3kX3aO1VxfhHqEWo5TiOYbvV88XpC7WcUqilhGePtWKtnLBxTn3gSLX3efvaKbXab4y9py2ekcDkhVq64vzr4Bi5mklouO_I8We3_QrW26nvAAAA__9oS4Am), including 54 previously classified documents. The files include handwritten notes from Sirhan Sirhan, Kennedy’s convicted killer, along with psychological profiles suggesting he acted alone and impulsively, not as part of a conspiracy. One note reads _“Kennedy must fall,”_ pointing to political motives over U.S. support for Israel. [See the note here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvwyAQBeBfgzei40xwPDB0YUvXjtbFnGMaDBbQRPn3lfsXOj_p03vv6zpdKcSQ7p-0sW1LnhK_auTWuEyhFuJYWwkPrqFQipE2otQmBDxLMFL1k6cQ35PuvF2YkfuOrRr0eIFRmaFbLY6Ke_IalSeNNxjn4eIH7ocZzyMDdsEeGhjVKwAD6jSaG-lRe6B-YENeaGAfWi6n7xxSW3mJ7_zkcprz1kW7trZX0X8IdAJdeu-5tiMS6A5YoAMj0CkU6H6qPPYJdHMgWTgyVa5yy4VlWylJBQBypztXmZMsy0NSrVRrSNRCTgJdV6zfXyHGUM0gNNw3CvGvSvvXf0-LvwEAAP__muGC4g). The documents also reveal Kennedy voluntarily provided intelligence to the CIA after a 1955 trip to the Soviet Union and detail failed CIA plots to poison Fidel Castro. Despite the findings, RFK Jr. continues to question the official story, citing autopsy evidence and alternative theories. The [documents can be accessed here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykz72O6yAQxfGnsbtYw0cgFBS3SZfbbokmMI5ng00EyFbefpV9he2OTvGT_l-3cEPOvD3-40q-zyVsdLRMvVMN3CpSbr3ykxpX3HLGFXHrQYI8n8CchAoJOb-DHpOfiSSpkbyw2l3ACWPHxc8XgxRB3GN097OyCSLZi7HoUJh0diP7jwZGKAFgQEzO3FE7nQCVJYNp0ECJe6nTd-GtLzTnd9mpTrGsY_ZL7682qH-DvA7yehzHhDUuvFObHmUf5LVSo8_1mfNzrD69Ds6Zm7GDhseKnH-p_qf-3cufAAAA__-JhW_K).

subject: The real reason your electric bill is going up, PA
body:
This is the group gouging consumers and blocking clean energy
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3681101/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Friend—

Your electric bill is higher than it should be—and PJM is the problem.

Here’s a simple truth: Clean energy is cheaper than fossil fuels—50 percent cheaper, in fact.

But **PJM Interconnection** , the company that controls the electric grid for our region, **is blocking clean energy and inflating your electric bill.** |
[](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3681102/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| PJM is supposed to ensure affordable, reliable electricity for 65 million people. But it is run by monopoly utility companies that make more money when they can charge you for gas and coal. So, PJM has spent the last five years delaying clean energy projects while raising your rates—and doubling executive salaries.

The average customer could save **more than $500 a year** if PJM simply let clean energy projects connect to the grid. But instead, less than 6 percent of PJM’s power comes from wind and solar. Other grid operators across the U.S. are doing better—cleaner energy, lower prices.

PJM? _One_ new clean energy project since 2020. **_One._**

**Here’s the kicker:** After lawmakers challenged them, PJM admitted they could drop rates by 25 percent. Translation? **They’ve been overcharging us—on purpose.**

We’re teaming up with state leaders to demand change—and your legislators need to know that you support cleaner, more affordable energy. [**Act now to tell them it’s time to hold PJM accountable and make electricity affordable again.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3681103/87SdQ4wZ) |
---

| **BREAKING: “Red Flag Day” Declared—Clown Car Parades Flood Connecticut in National Protest of Reality**
**By Dominic Rapini, American Businessman and Political Commentator**
**June 14** — formerly known as Flag Day, when Americans take a moment to salute the stars and stripes — has now been unofficially rebranded by the nation’s most dedicated unemployed performance artists as **“Red Flag Day”** , a celebration of public tantrums, handcrafted signs, and confusing chants that even their organizers don’t fully understand.
Across Connecticut, **34 separate interpretive protests** are planned, where a small but determined group of disenchanted interpretive dancers, grievance sommeliers, and TikTok philosophers will rally in passionate opposition to... well, anything that resembles functioning government, borders, or grown-up conversations.
These gatherings, lovingly referred to as **Court Jester Conventions** , are being held to express solidarity with career criminals, illegal border crossings, and anyone who’s ever tweeted “ACAB” while still calling 911 when their Starbucks mobile order gets skipped. The movement’s slogan? “No Jobs, No Peace.”
But fear not, **Normies of America**. There’s no need to argue with the fool circus. Remember what the great (and probably exasperated) Mark Twain said: _“Never argue with a fool, onlookers may not be able to tell the difference.”_ Which is why the best course of action is **not engagement** , but documentation.
Yes, citizen journalists: **grab your cameras, your phones, your emotional support telephoto lenses** — and peacefully observe. Snap a few photos of the pageantry. Think: if Burning Man and a Civics D-minus had a baby. Then send them to dominic@dominicforCT.us so we can lovingly **curate this gallery of democracy’s blooper reel**.
These images will be compiled into an official “Highlight Reel of Wokeness,” available to our **federal candidates and state party leaders** who prefer their political discourse with a side of reality and a dash of basic logic. Because while 19% of the country might think the justice system should only apply to people they don’t brunch with, **81% of Americans are done with the clown show**.
So on June 14, go out. Watch. Record. Don’t poke the performers. And remember: **we win by letting them speak for themselves — loudly, proudly, and incoherently.**
Happy Red Flag Day. God Bless America — and pass the popcorn.

| | | Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem was holding a press conference, a thing that was literally created so questions could be answered. **But when U.S. Senator Alex Padilla of California tried to ask a question,[he was forcibly pushed out of the room, thrown to the ground, and handcuffed.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T295711c8-145f-46e7-b828-ac00ce84aab8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** WTF? If this is how one of the highest elected officials in the country is treated, just imagine how the rest of us would fare in that situation (or don't imagine it, just read the papers and see what's already happening). **Don't let them normalize this.[There needs to be an investigation, and if appropriate, criminal penalties.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td0e96703-55d6-438a-8021-5fbc70fdeb11/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** [**Add your name, and demand this happen ASAP.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te3f4cf18-85e0-4364-be10-7bcf0d57e05f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Stefanik blasted Hochul for extending New York's sanctuary state policies, barring state law enforcement from targeting individuals based on their immigration status and preventing federal agents from taking action to enforce immigration policy in the state.
"Do you know who Sakir Akkan is?!" Stefanik asked Hochul, visibly angry. "You should as the Governor of New York State!"
"Refresh my recollection," Hochul said halfheartedly.
**["He was an illegal migrant in New York](https://substack.com/redirect/52dd348a-848b-40b3-a82a-beda9d7bab12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**, and do you know what crime he committed in addition to being here illegally?!" Stefanik pressed.
"No I do not," Hochul admitted.
"You do not? This was widely reported!" Stefanik exploded. "He found a 15-year-old girl, threatened her with a metal pole, told her to get into the back seat of his car, he took her clothes off and he violently r*ped her!"
Stefanik cited another case of an illegal migrant, Sebastian Zepeta, **[who burned a woman on the subway alive](https://substack.com/redirect/b2587ee3-543c-4993-89f1-4079457c05a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , along with several other horrendous cases that Hochul showed no awareness of.
"This is Kathy Hochul's New York,... they're horrific crimes that are committed on your watch!!!" Stefanik erupted.

# Trump calls Israel's strike on Iran "excellent"
**Trump praised Israel's strikes on Iran as "excellent"** during an interview with ABC News, and warned of more attacks to come. The president told ABC News that Iran "got hit hard, very hard" and "about as hard as you're going to get hit," while promising "there's more to come, a lot more" as Israel attempts to destroy Iran's nuclear program.
* **Trump blamed Iran for rejecting previous nuclear deal opportunities and urged them to negotiate** \- **[In Truth Social posts,](https://substack.com/redirect/01125fa2-feb6-4e8c-af64-dda0b73cd1a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Trump said he gave Iran "chance after chance to make a deal" and told them to "just do it," warning that while there's still time to end the "slaughter," the "next already planned attacks" will be "even more brutal."
"Iran must make a deal, before there is nothing left, and save what was once known as the Iranian Empire. No more death, no more destruction, JUST DO IT, BEFORE IT IS TOO LATE," Trump wrote on Truth Social.

* * *
# Netanyahu confirms why Israel attacked Iran last night
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu **[confirmed Friday that Israel struck Iran's main nuclear enrichment facility](https://substack.com/redirect/8fba462e-53f1-42a2-ae49-aaf0daf9f3c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at Natanz in overnight attacks, warning that Iran has produced enough uranium for nine nuclear weapons and is taking steps toward weaponization as Tehran launched approximately 100 retaliatory drones.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/dda254f4-06dd-4eec-95c8-6700692a4a4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Iran has enough uranium for nine nuclear bombs and is moving toward weaponization** \- Netanyahu warned that Iran has produced sufficient highly enriched uranium for nine atom bombs and is taking unprecedented steps to weaponize this material, potentially producing a nuclear weapon "in a very short time" if not stopped.
* **Iran launched approximately 100 retaliatory drones following the Israeli attack** \- Hours after Netanyahu's confirmation, Iranian forces fired around 100 drones toward Israeli territory, which the IDF was working to intercept, escalating the conflict between the two nations.
* **Multiple Iranian military sites were reportedly damaged in the overnight strikes** \- In addition to the Natanz facility, reports indicate Israel also hit the Parchin military complex (which houses nuclear weapons research) and five military bases around Tehran, though the full extent of damage to these underground and heavily fortified facilities remains unknown.

# Democrat senator dragged away in handcuffs after disrupting Noem's press conference
Democrat California Senator Alex Padilla was **[forcibly removed and handcuffed](https://substack.com/redirect/dd776926-3433-45c5-ac37-c8e6c993dd95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during DHS Secretary Kristi Noem's press conference after interrupting the event and causing a commotion.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/73a916d6-c320-4a8a-aace-4a8a0bf3ab73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Security told Padilla to put his hands up** and escorted him out after he interrupted Noem's briefing about the Los Angeles riots, with the Secret Service apparently viewing him as a potential "attacker" according to DHS officials.

* **Padilla ignored repeated commands to back away and "lunged toward" the Secretary** \- DHS Assistant Secretary Tricia McLaughlin said Padilla was told multiple times to back away but didn't comply with officers' commands, leading to his removal, though the two later held a 15-minute meeting after the press conference ended.
* **The incident is part of a pattern of Democratic lawmakers disrupting Trump administration events** \- DHS characterized Padilla's actions as "disrespectful political theatre," noting similar recent incidents including Rep. LaMonica McIver's federal indictment following an immigration center incident and Rep. Al Green being escorted off the House floor during Trump's congressional address.

**How do we take care of the most people possible while complying with purposefully vague and outdated laws?**

It's a question no health care professionals should have to ask a lawyer. Unfortunately, it's a question we hear all the time from our clients. Peter, thanks to supporters like you, we're able to give clinics and providers the expert legal guidance they need—**completely free of charge** —to stay open and care for their communities. [**And right now, you have a unique opportunity to double your impact with a 2X match.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109510164/551338837/1126318745?sourceid=1150755&utm_campaign=25emius-0602aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTVjZDcyMS01ZjQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hbi0K0MT1KAOt5LEHUWXbZO5_VVBpBFj5pOtJcI6BYI=&emci=d21eb154-c547-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=995cd721-5f48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=954237) | [**2X YOUR IMPACT**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109510165/551338838/1126318745?sourceid=1150755&utm_campaign=25emius-0602aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTVjZDcyMS01ZjQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hbi0K0MT1KAOt5LEHUWXbZO5_VVBpBFj5pOtJcI6BYI=&emci=d21eb154-c547-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=995cd721-5f48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=954237 "2X YOUR IMPACT")
---
When _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned in 2022, Tennessee was one of many U.S. states with a "trigger ban" on the books, meaning they had enacted a total abortion ban that would take effect automatically after the Supreme Court issued a decision.

Tennessee's ban took effect shortly after the ruling, forcing clinics to halt abortion care. Our longtime client CHOICES, a Memphis-based reproductive health center offering everything from birth care to gender-affirming care, had to quickly adapt.
[**With our legal support, CHOICES opened a second clinic in Illinois in October 2023, addressing a vast abortion desert across the South and Midwest. Today, they provide care to patients from over 21 states, reimagining what reproductive health access can look like in a post-_Roe_ landscape.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109510166/551338839/1126318745?sourceid=1150755&utm_campaign=25emius-0602aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTVjZDcyMS01ZjQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hbi0K0MT1KAOt5LEHUWXbZO5_VVBpBFj5pOtJcI6BYI=&emci=d21eb154-c547-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=995cd721-5f48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=954237)
[**SUPPORT OUR FIGHT**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109510167/551338840/1126318745?sourceid=1150755&utm_campaign=25emius-0602aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTVjZDcyMS01ZjQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hbi0K0MT1KAOt5LEHUWXbZO5_VVBpBFj5pOtJcI6BYI=&emci=d21eb154-c547-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=995cd721-5f48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=954237 "SUPPORT OUR FIGHT")
---
Earlier this week, we shared a powerful letter from Jennifer Pepper, President and CEO of CHOICES, underscoring how bold leadership—backed by strong legal support, free of charge—helps clinics adapt and continue delivering essential care despite constant threats.
[**Your generosity powers this work—free legal support that independent clinics and providers rely on to survive and continue delivering essential care, even under relentless attack.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109510168/551338841/1126318745?sourceid=1150755&utm_campaign=25emius-0602aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTVjZDcyMS01ZjQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hbi0K0MT1KAOt5LEHUWXbZO5_VVBpBFj5pOtJcI6BYI=&emci=d21eb154-c547-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=995cd721-5f48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=954237)
Together, we'll fight to protect and expand reproductive rights for generations to come.

In solidarity,

Autumn Katz
Interim Director, U.S. Litigation

body:
A breakthrough... in California?
\- This tour went somewhere no one thought we’d reach - The Left’s strongholds are crumbling - This generation is choosing freedom - The comeback is happening — and YOU made it possible - This wasn’t just noise... - Packed crowds. Roaring students. The Left? Speechless. - We’re beating the Left. On their turf.

| | | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c0be01fcf2564c2ca3b329204799a74a&_e=iGZ11Ko9b6_L2olS39Pafb5jhLylDj6hGSMV_Fbb3Dfrz4ISTxS0WydmkR-IFggLwuTOt7FddMtVfOz4SPvUxl7SgoI2BIFbOOw8Ske4ZLEOoVOx3LZ03u_wRW2kXFf2tHM8gR5C6EaCwb40Ds6ipafL-g3x7_H6KcO43m_mSxRsw6_ZMNlWNxn_6hWv-2dxo2U0F-wpIaJKy1aJa4Mpg2kA7AKeJ8e5_7_J8JQfxQ3WL5wIWQwnizNx6w3oCaXYdjVxh6IRYXhbVzA3gvtDUhNQ5Ng4-ygRvzS2IJathdEyYkfY_Q22yZBjynKSKNNR)

Fellow Patriot, I’ve written a lot of messages to patriots like you over the years... but never one quite like this.Because I’ve never had this much good news to share. And I’ve never felt this much urgency to say one thing: **THANK YOU.** I don’t know if you’ve ever felt something just... _shift..._ while it was happening... But this spring on the American Comeback Tour?**I did.** And if you were standing where I stood — listening to the crowd roar before I walked up to the “Prove Me Wrong” table at our Spring Finale at UC Riverside...You would’ve felt this generational shift in real time, too.
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c0be01fcf2564c2ca3b329204799a74a&_e=iGZ11Ko9b6_L2olS39Pafb5jhLylDj6hGSMV_Fbb3Dfrz4ISTxS0WydmkR-IFggLwuTOt7FddMtVfOz4SPvUxl7SgoI2BIFbOOw8Ske4ZLEOoVOx3LZ03u_wRW2kXFf2tHM8gR5C6EaCwb40Ds6ipeXya5oW3YzwJQ0rEWqjjpwnpHic_ZkSSplQS1eQxwBeu0Eqyytr5lstPsuPCcS3Dyqi7KnApcpxn_9_0Bzx97b3Ti_zrmhR_ZlKYf7gCXyhFnmQ0pN5Ertfz16FlXfoBQzGdw9n-X3BImd5UQAHo83fFbrtmjv-So2pif5x4Opb)
---
You may have seen the photos from the tour... caught some of the videos... read about the chants of _“USA!”_ from students...But let me tell you exactly what happened this spring:**Patriots like you helped launch the most powerful Conservative campus tour in American history.** It was BOLD. It was LOUD. And it was PACKED... From beginning to end.**And the American Comeback Tour’s Spring FINALE was in a place no one thought we’d ever touch: California.** The same state where Leftist professors shut down free speech... where mobs scream in the faces of our students... where conservative ideas aren’t just unpopular — _they’re punishable offenses._ And yet... We filled the campus quad at UC Riverside.Students came early. Packed shoulder-to-shoulder. Ringing around the “Prove Me Wrong” tent to hear the truth.And when I walked on stage and said: “It’s okay to love America...”They ERUPTED.
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c0be01fcf2564c2ca3b329204799a74a&_e=iGZ11Ko9b6_L2olS39Pafb5jhLylDj6hGSMV_Fbb3Dfrz4ISTxS0WydmkR-IFggLwuTOt7FddMtVfOz4SPvUxl7SgoI2BIFbOOw8Ske4ZLEOoVOx3LZ03u_wRW2kXFf2tHM8gR5C6EaCwb40Ds6ipTOOx8QP1I6s4OhEktlu_zWMJLoV2iBtR8zy-sh6EzefYIepz-rTIJzKiNvbHF9069cRSCvCNkvubjTUZIwqKh9rgxVDxoPW8x88LmxOKuY6Ws-SAC_uhkojhW7kOw8dKHFWnme-AAHiesgPzlORt0dCm4M_ct1-kT-NALuL93wh)
---
It wasn’t just another great tour stop... **It was a BREAKTHROUGH.** Because this wasn’t the first stop in California this spring — it was the fourth IN MAY and the SIXTH of the tour.And each one was just as powerful...This wasn’t just another campus tour. _It was a line in the sand._ And every single time, the story was the same: The Left tried to dismiss us, hurl their obscenities, or shut us down...The students showed up anyway. And the truth rang out louder than ever before._But let’s back up for a moment..._ Because while the California finale may have been the last stop of the Spring, this all started months ago.**Back in January, when we were laying out the calendar... These were the goals: Go BIGGER. Go BOLDER. Go DEEPER into Leftist territory.** We wanted to hit not just the battleground states... Not just the safe “Red” states... _But the ones the Left claimed as their own._ And then? We wanted to plant our flag. And because of patriots like you — that’s exactly what we did.**Let me give you the big picture:** ✅ 21 American Comeback Tour stops✅ Overflow crowds with thousands of students✅ Deep “Blue” states seeing young people rising up ✅ The Left rattled by a movement of young people who are rejecting them... _wholesale._ Students who had never once heard a Conservative speak in person... _finally heard one._ Students who were afraid to wear a cross or sport an American flag... _were loud, proud, and unashamed to stand for God and their country._ Students who were told they were alone... _realized they were part of something BIGGER than they ever imagined._ There are too many great stories, moments and pictures to pack into this one message...**But just look at what we're accomplishing:**
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c0be01fcf2564c2ca3b329204799a74a&_e=iGZ11Ko9b6_L2olS39Pafb5jhLylDj6hGSMV_Fbb3Dfrz4ISTxS0WydmkR-IFggLwuTOt7FddMtVfOz4SPvUxl7SgoI2BIFbOOw8Ske4ZLEOoVOx3LZ03u_wRW2kXFf2tHM8gR5C6EaCwb40Ds6ipSPMDQrtVbUKkYZGD99ETqLS85FVwfVF8buxOZEgyJkLfFb3JXKC3D78q7H8hvPkLnktcstBG7vpegO6R3LxLccN2-_6sePV51BTj0dZ2JTFUyN2bwu2OkRJ-68rQmURNqT6IH4HJRDIptR8x53ubmPk3MngwwxvGq-GINsViP_q)
---
_Fellow Patriot, this is why we fight..._ Not just for campus speeches. Not just for questions from students.**But for a generation-wide cultural reset — playing out in real time, in real places, in the hearts of real students.** This is why the American Comeback Tour matters.And I hope you know:**It wouldn’t exist without patriots like****YOU****.** Your support — your prayers, your belief in our students, your generous gifts — made all of this possible.Patriots like you put us on the road. You brought us onto these campuses. You sent us to the students who needed to hear our America First message the most.**You weren’t just watching this tour... You were powering it.** Now, let me be totally honest: _We’re not done. Not even close._ The American Comeback Tour may have just ended for the spring...But this summer?We’re preparing for something even BIGGER. We’re already mapping out new stops in the fall. New states. New targets in Leftist territory to break through.We’re building a plan to take this movement to the next level — to complete the cultural shift that started on this tour.To reach more students. To change more hearts and minds. **And raise up the boldest, most unapologetic generation of freedom-loving Americans since the founding of this country. **_I’m going to need you fighting alongside me, Fellow Patriot._ Because now that we’ve tasted victory... now that we’ve seen what’s possible...We can’t back down. Not now. _Not ever._ Let’s keep building. Let’s keep pushing. Let’s keep GOING.The American Comeback is well underway. Let’s make sure it keeps rolling strong.**I can’t say “thank you” enough to the patriots like you who’ve helped make Turning Point USA the force it is today.****Together, we’re SAVING America... one student at a time.**
---
For America, Charlie Kirk
Founder & CEO
Turning Point USA

They’re hungry for the truth and our ideas.This country is shifting — In a way you can genuinely FEEL.**And the Left is terrified.** You can see it in their mobs... The way they lash out at us and our students... But it’s not working anymore.**Because you and I are reaching the next generation — campus by campus, state by state, student by student.** **And that’s why I’m asking you to stand with us again today. Because every dollar you give today will be MATCHED.** That means your gift of $50 becomes $100... $100 becomes $200... And your impact? DOUBLED. _So, if you believe in this mission... If you’re proud of what we’re accomplishing... If you want to go even BIGGER this fall..._ Then this is your moment to step up and fuel what comes next.Let’s take the American Comeback Tour to every corner of this country when it returns this fall... Let’s train thousands of students this summer at our events to become the LEADERS we need for our America First movement...And let’s make sure the Left NEVER thinks they can own the hearts of America’s young people again. **[We’re not done. Let’s go DEFEAT the Left once and for all. Let me explain why this fight is more important than ever right now.
You see, back in 2010, the Supreme Court's misguided Citizens United __ decision opened the door for billionaires, corporations and special-interest groups to spend unlimited amounts on elections. **Today, we're seeing the devastating result: a government that works for corporations, at the expense of workers.**
I'm sure you, your family members or your neighbors have most likely felt the effects: stagnant wages, higher costs for everything from housing to groceries to health care, and dwindling retirement savings. Well, now, it's time to fight back.
**We need to get dark money out of politics. We need to elect leaders who will put workers first. We need to create an economy where people benefit from the wealth they create. I believe we can do all this and more, but it's going to take all of us, friend.**

I hold a Master’s from Harvard, a Master’s Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. name: BAF Action Fund
subject: Trump's Birthday Parade - A Big Waste of Time and Resources
body:
Tomorrow, tanks will roll down Constitution Avenue in Washington, D.C. The official reason? To mark the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States Army. But we all know what’s really happening.| | |
---
| | Dear Supporter, Tomorrow, around 6:30 p.m., tanks will roll down Constitution Avenue in Washington, D.C. The official reason? To mark the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States Army.**But we all know what’s really happening**.

This is President Trump’s big birthday parade—the one he never got during his first term. He’s using this anniversary as an excuse to put on a show of strength, to play the tough guy, while actively undermining the very democracy our military has fought to defend.

**It’s a waste of time. It’s a waste of resources.** It’s an insult to the men and women who wear the uniform and to the generations who came before them. And honestly, with everything Trump is doing right now, we can’t think of anyone who deserves a parade less.

But, like it or not, this parade is going to happen.

**What matters most now is what comes after—and that’s why we’re reaching out to you today.**

While Trump spends millions of taxpayer dollars on this unnecessary spectacle, we are working tirelessly—entirely volunteer—to promote democracy, transparency, and responsible leadership.

Build Alaska’s Future operates a [501(c)(4) social welfare organization](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109513471/551347643/1533895835?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTgyMDA2OC02NDQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eyfpGJvETEHLuyP4_Eef3ZAN6V6bnN6B3aJJ7zg6S1c=&emci=63b8a76c-5f48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=4e820068-6448-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=9512399) dedicated to advocating for accountable governance, fighting corruption, and ensuring that the voices of everyday Americans are heard. Unlike nonprofits that focus solely on charitable activities, our C4 allows us to engage in advocacy and support policies and candidates committed to transparency, honest leadership, and protecting our democracy.

**We believe that patriotism is about supporting the values that make our nation strong—not costly displays meant to distract us from real issues.**

**[We need your help](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109513473/551347645/1172432375?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTgyMDA2OC02NDQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eyfpGJvETEHLuyP4_Eef3ZAN6V6bnN6B3aJJ7zg6S1c=&emci=63b8a76c-5f48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=4e820068-6448-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=9512399#contribute). Your support will enable us to:**
* Spread the truth about what’s happening
* Mobilize communities to stand for transparency and accountability
* Advocate for responsible leadership and fiscal responsibility
* Fight back against wasteful spending and political spectacle

Please support our work today at [BAFaction.org](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109513475/551347647/1533895835?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTgyMDA2OC02NDQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eyfpGJvETEHLuyP4_Eef3ZAN6V6bnN6B3aJJ7zg6S1c=&emci=63b8a76c-5f48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=4e820068-6448-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=9512399). Every contribution helps us amplify our voice and defend the principles that make America great.

**Together, we can resist the distraction of empty displays and focus on what truly matters—building a democracy that works for all of us.**

Thank you for your commitment and support.

BAF Action Team

My name is Ryan Crosswell, and this week, I officially launched my campaign to represent Pennsylvania’s 7th District in Congress.
Donald Trump asked me to ignore the law. I said no.
Every citizen who cares about American democracy must have a line in the sand that cannot be crossed.
My name is Ryan Crosswell, and this week, I officially launched my campaign to represent Pennsylvania’s 7th District in Congress — because Donald Trump crossed my line.
**[If Donald Trump has crossed your line, please consider splitting a donation between Heartland Patriots and my campaign to help me reach my Launch Week Digital Goal. Every dollar we raise sends a message to Donald Trump that this is our country, and we’re going to fight for it.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89547?refcode=em20250613-9004&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9004%2E614464%2ElilOwp)**

I grew up in Pottsville, Pennsylvania. Motivated to serve because of 9/11, I joined the Marine Corps, where I learned the code of Honor, Courage, and Commitment.
I kept that code during my time as a federal prosecutor under Presidents Obama, Biden, and Trump.
I locked up child predators, took on drug traffickers, and took down corrupt politicians — until the day Donald Trump decided to weaponize the Department of Justice to go after his political opponents and let his friends off the hook.
He wanted the prosecutors in my section to drop a case against his political ally. He wanted me to break the code and ignore the law, and that’s something I would never do.
**So I said no and resigned from the Department of Justice — then, I fought back.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89547?refcode=em20250613-9004&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=9004%2E614464%2ElilOwp)
I testified publicly in a congressional hearing about the threat Donald Trump’s agenda poses to our justice system, the integrity of the federal government, and our democracy itself.
I don’t have the deep pockets of the big corporations that are ripping us off while hardworking Pennsylvanians fight like hell just to get by, or the influence of the corrupt politicians who keep the game rigged against everyday Americans, or the power Trump has forcibly seized for himself.
But that won’t stop me from fighting back against him again — with Honor, Courage, and a Commitment to the real people and families of Pennsylvania’s 7th.
**[I’d be honored to have you by my side in this fight for the long haul. If you’re all in to flip the House blue and put a real check on Donald Trump’s power in 2026, I’m personally asking you to split a donation between Heartland Patriots and my campaign today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89547?refcode=em20250613-9004&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=9004%2E614464%2ElilOwp)**

Folks: An update from the federal 8th Circuit on one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years .
A federal appeals court recently cut off a key avenue for private groups and individuals to bring racial discrimination claims under the Voting Rights Act (VRA). The ruling, which applies in seven states, further weakens the ability of our civil rights law to protect voters, and could lead to the Supreme Court settling the issue.
This goes back to an initial ruling from 2023, the impact of which is pretty simple to understand: That voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act. According to the 8th Circuit, and now confirmed on appeal, only the Department of Justice (DoJ) has the legal standing to sue states over voting laws.
With former Florida AG Pam Bondi -- a "big lie" spreading MAGA acolyte -- serving as Attorney General, it's clear that the DOJ is not going to protect voting rights over the next four years.

This is all about the legal term "private right of action". The 8th Circuit says it doesn't exist. That means the pro-voting lawsuits we've seen in states like Wisconsin, Georgia, Florida, and others nationwide wouldn't be possible anymore if the Supreme Court backs up this ruling.

| | | | | [|
---](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=39ec775b1d&e=e907534017)
| | | | | **June 13, 2025**
---
| | | | | _**I believe that only U.S. citizens should vote in U.S elections, but Democrats in Congress disagree.**_
---
| Under Washington, D.C.’s weak election integrity system, a noncitizen working in an embassy, holding a foreign passport, can walk out of the office, down the street, and into a polling location to vote. All they have to do is live in D.C. for thirty days.
---
[|
---](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=935d15917d&e=e907534017)
| This week, I supported legislation that would end D.C’s radical practice of allowing noncitizens to vote in elections.
The reform is a simple but powerful part of returning integrity and security to our elections. It ensures that only American citizens can vote in American elections in our nation’s capital. No citizen’s vote should be canceled out by a foreign national or illegal immigrant.
_**Ensuring that only citizens vote in U.S. elections shouldn’t be controversial, yet Democrats and the Left are terrified that we want to protect the integrity of our elections - why?**_
---
[|
---](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=49f3512f29&e=e907534017)

The Left wants to use Washington, D.C. as a petri dish to test their radical policies before the 2026 election. We cannot allow them to succeed.
We must continue to do everything we can to ensure our elections are safe, secure, and fair.

Peter, Donald Trump and his corrupt administration have escalated their attacks on federal judges — putting their safety and security at risk. Let me be very clear about this: **If federal judges fear for their lives or the safety of their families just for doing their jobs, then we are no longer living in a democracy governed by the rule of law.** But that’s exactly the risk many judges are facing today, because Donald Trump has spent the last several weeks targeting them by name, attacking their integrity, and inciting threats against them. And it’s working. Threats against federal judges have skyrocketed by over **100% in just the past six weeks.** That’s why I’m leading a **bipartisan** effort to fund the _Daniel Anderl Judicial Security and Privacy Act_ — legislation to help state and local governments remove judges’ personal information from the internet and protect them from doxxing and violence. Judges should be safe from fear and intimidation. They should never worry about the safety of their families. And no elected official, especially not a president, should ever be allowed to endanger them for political gain. **Trump’s tactics are authoritarian. His goal is to intimidate the courts, silence our voices, and dismantle the very foundations of justice in this country. clean_body: | Peter, Donald Trump and his corrupt administration have escalated their attacks on federal judges — putting their safety and security at risk. Let me be very clear about this: If federal judges fear for their lives or the safety of their families just for doing their jobs, then we are no longer living in a democracy governed by the rule of law. But that’s exactly the risk many judges are facing today, because Donald Trump has spent the last several weeks targeting them by name, attacking their integrity, and inciting threats against them. And it’s working. Threats against federal judges have skyrocketed by over 100% in just the past six weeks. That’s why I’m leading a bipartisan effort to fund the Daniel Anderl Judicial Security and Privacy Act — legislation to help state and local governments remove judges’ personal information from the internet and protect them from doxxing and violence. Judges should be safe from fear and intimidation. They should never worry about the safety of their families. And no elected official, especially not a president, should ever be allowed to endanger them for political gain. Trump’s tactics are authoritarian. His goal is to intimidate the courts, silence our voices, and dismantle the very foundations of justice in this country. body:
| | |

| | Hi Friend , Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter! As this is our last newsletter ahead of the Juneteenth holiday, we want to take a moment to reflect on the historical significance of the holiday. Juneteenth commemorates the day, June 19th 1865, when enslaved Black people in Galveston, TX finally learned they were free from chattel slavery - although two years late - post the signing of the Emancipation Proclamation. Juneteenth celebrates freedom. As civil rights icon, Fannie Lou Hamer proclaimed, “None of us are free until all of us are free.” Happy Juneteenth! We invite you to read about our work, our upcoming events, and the ways you can safely participate in events happening across Pennsylvania.

What does retention election even mean?

PA voters decide whether to keep the current judges on the PA Supreme Court (SCOPA).

These are nonpartisan, yes-or-no votes where voters decide whether a judge should serve another term.

Judges do not face opponents, and their political affiliations are not listed on the ballot. This system aims to insulate judges from political pressures once they are on the bench.

clean_body: | | | | | Hi Friend , Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter! As this is our last newsletter ahead of the Juneteenth holiday, we want to take a moment to reflect on the historical significance of the holiday. Juneteenth commemorates the day, June 19th 1865, when enslaved Black people in Galveston, TX finally learned they were free from chattel slavery - although two years late - post the signing of the Emancipation Proclamation. Juneteenth celebrates freedom. As civil rights icon, Fannie Lou Hamer proclaimed, “None of us are free until all of us are free.” Happy Juneteenth! We invite you to read about our work, our upcoming events, and the ways you can safely participate in events happening across Pennsylvania. | | | In Case You Missed It: Episode 5 of Slingshot The Podcast Has Dropped | | "Ballers’ Lives Are Political, Too!" You can watch anywhere you get your podcasts! This isn’t just a sports episode. It’s a powerful look at how deeply intertwined Black identity, public expectation, and power truly are.New episodes drop Thursdays at 12PM ET What happens when athletes are told to “stick to sports”—but politics won't stick to them? In Episode 5 of Slingshot The Podcast, hosts Charles and Kadida are joined by Paul “Boo Boo” Palmer, Temple football legend and former NFL running back, for an unfiltered conversation about the inescapable politics of sports, race, and identity. From his time at Temple and the NFL to deeply personal experiences with racism—including a disturbing piece of LDS literature sent to his college dorm before a game against BYU—Paul reflects on how Black athletes have always been political, even when they didn’t ask to be. Episode 6 drops Thursday, June 19th! PA voters decide whether to keep the current judges on the PA Supreme Court (SCOPA). These are nonpartisan, yes-or-no votes where voters decide whether a judge should serve another term. This system aims to insulate judges from political pressures once they are on the bench. | | | | | A win for PA voters! | | | | | [|

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Dear Friend,
This past week I officially announced my campaign to unseat Senator Susan Collins in 2026. For those who don’t know me, I was born in Bangor and raised in Old Town, by my mother and maternal grandparents. My father, an Army veteran and labororganizer, died at the age of thirty-one because of hazardous work he did as a teenager.
I decided to challenge Senator Collins because I want to help in ending the Trump Administration’s and GOP Congress’s reckless assault on our democracy, environment and economy. Repair damage already done and enact long-overdue reforms to protect against future assaults and ensure that all Mainers, not just the wealthy, are provided with the education, job skills, healthcare, and other life enriching opportunities to thrive.
Senator Collins, aside from expressing concern, has done little to prevent the TrumpAdministration and her Republican colleagues from undermining our economy, ourcritical government programs, and our nation’s long-standing defense of democracyagainst authoritarianism and Russian aggression.
In 2024, I campaigned to strengthen our democracy and bolster the federalgovernment’s ability to address such pressing challenges as climate change; lack ofaffordable housing and health care; economic inequality; and insufficient retirementsecurity. Challenges the Trump Administration and Senator Collins and her Republican colleagues are either ignoring, or worse yet, exacerbating.
Having grown up in working-class family in Old Town and having served for more than 30 years in senior-level government and non-government positions, both in the United States and abroad – managing, not simply legislating or talking about complex multi-million-dollar programs and operations – I believe that I have the broadest and most fitting knowledge and experience to defeat Senator Collins in 2026 and best represent Maine in the United States Senate.
For more information, please visit costelloforsenate.com and consider joining me byeither donating your time or a small amount of money, or by simply sharing this emailwith your family and friends.
Best,David
About David – Background, Knowledge, and Experience Matters
**Born in Bangor and Raised in a Working-Class Family in Old Town** Son of an Army veteran and labor organizer. Grandson of French and Irish American shoe, textile, and railroad workers.**Graduate of Old Town High, George Washington University, and****the London Schools of Economics********Senior Aide, Maine Secretary of State** Developed elections, campaign finance, and motor vehicle safety reforms.**Maine Senate Aide** **Country Program and Regional Team Leader, United States Agency for****International Development (USAID)** Conducted and managed foreign aid work in such conflict torn countries as Cambodia, Haiti, Bosnia, Croatia, Serbia, and Kosovo.
**Senior Aide, Mayor of Baltimore** Directed community efforts to improve City’s schools and City’s assistance to children, youth, and families at risk.
**Assistant Secretary, Maryland Department of Planning (MDP)** Managed cross-agency efforts to support smarter, more sustainable growth.
**Senior Aide, Governor of Maryland** Directed cross-agency efforts to achieve Governor’s most important goals.
**Deputy and Acting Secretary, Maryland Department of the Environment (MDE**)Helped to manage 1,000+ employees, various programs, and $380 million annualbudget.
**Climate Action Now! and Energize Maryland Projects Coordinator** Directed foundation funded projects to aggressively tackle climate change.

The freedom to rise, the freedom to learn, the freedom from violence, and the freedom to govern ourselves.
Friends, I believe that every American is entitled to those four fundamental freedoms. Those values are what have guided my work in public service.
Here’s how we can achieve these freedoms right here in Colorado:
By ensuring Colorado families can afford healthcare, childcare, and housing; by fighting childhood poverty; and by building an economy that works for everyone, not just those at the top, we can achieve the freedom to rise.
By modernizing our education system to set our kids up for success, no matter what zip code they are born into, and paying our educators what they deserve, we can achieve the freedom to learn.
By partnering with local law enforcement and communities to keep Coloradans safe, fighting the opioid epidemic, and combating the extremism that flourishes on social media, we can achieve freedom from violence.
By protecting Coloradans' voting rights, keeping the government out of our bedrooms and doctors' offices, and reforming our electoral system so the people, not dark money, have the most power, we can achieve the freedom to govern ourselves.
Achieving these goals in the political climate we are living through right now may feel impossible, but I know fighting for what is fundamental will always be worth it.
That’s why I’m running for Governor. Working together, right here at home, we can truly achieve these fundamental freedoms and provide the rest of the country with the hopeful and optimistic vision we desperately need.
Friend, I can’t and wouldn’t want to do without you by our side. If you want to join me in this campaign, consider chipping in what you can today. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_mfb_email-25q2-g?refcode=X_250613_fourfreedomsjune_act]
