body:
Los Angeles is under siege.

| | | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aDwd/?__vbtrk=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Fellow patriot, foreign nationals have **_stormed our homeland_****,**__**_flooded the streets of an American city_****,** and **_draped themselves in foreign flags_** as they burn businesses, terrorize our people, and assault our police officers.
**[This is an occupation. This is an act of aggression that can not – and must not – be tolerated.](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aDwd/?__vbtrk=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aDwd/?__vbtrk=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Los Angeles under siege_
Our movement to Make America Safe Again has led up to this moment.
Foreign-born, military-aged males are currently laying siege to an American city that was once the envy of the world. They are doing this because they have no respect for our laws or our nation.
The violent criminals burning down Los Angeles hate our country. They hate you. They hate everything our country stands for. This is not a time to sit on our hands.
President Trump knows this which is why he has taken immediate decisive action by deploying the **National Guard** to contain the riots and put an end to the destruction. And they are now joined by hundreds of brave **United States Marines** who are ready to defend our homeland.
Those who have served in our military know what is on the line. Our military did not spill their blood overseas just to see an invasion of unvetted criminals take over our country.
**[The criminals will not stop until we stop them. That’s why we need to send in the Marines.](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aDwd/?__vbtrk=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aDwd/?__vbtrk=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Rioters waving foreign flags during the riots_
Criminals, draped in foreign flags, are _throwing bricks at police officers_ , _terrorizing Americans civilians_ , and _occupying parts of our country_ through violence and claiming it as their own.
LA’s first responders who put their lives on the line courageously held the line but were at risk of being overwhelmed. The brave soldiers and marines that President Trump deployed to help them quell the violence are the finest in the world. They will put a stop to the chaos on the streets of LA but time is of the essence.
**We are under attack, those on the frontline need backup, and we must act accordingly.**
**[That’s why we are requesting our fellow citizens to let Republican leadership know where you stand:](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aDwd/?__vbtrk=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**
**[We need to know if the American People support the deployment of National Guard to Los Angeles and if more U.S. Marines should be deployed to defend our country](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aDwd/?__vbtrk=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct).**
Friend, our team is asking you not as a donor or a subscriber but as a concerned patriot who, like us, is seeing red and feeling your blood run like tar at the sight of our home being desecrated by invaders.
Elitists from the Democrat Party and liberal media, who don’t have to deal with the consequences of the riots, are demanding our forces stand down and claim that Americans are on their side. We want to show the nation that these cowards are DEAD WRONG.
**We believe the American People fully support sending in reinforcements from our military to protect our cities from enemies both _foreign_****and**** _domestic_****.**
The situation is developing every hour and decisions are being made rapidly so please answer the poll right now and tell us if you support the actions taken thus far and if you believe more Marines should be deployed to Los Angeles to support our brave law enforcement.
[YES - SEND IN THE MARINES](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aDwd/?__vbtrk=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
[NO - DON’T SEND IN REINFORCEMENTS](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aDwd/?__vbtrk=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Thank you in advance for your time and aid.
It is because of the vocal support of patriots like you that we can continue to fight for President Trump’s America First agenda in Congress and the public square every day.
_For America,_
**THE HOUSE GOP**
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aDwd/?__vbtrk=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk1ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

name: AOC
subject: Senator Padilla
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
I think we need to see this for what it is. There’s two grave and extremely alarming elements to what just happened with Senator Alex Padilla:
First and foremost, a United States Senator who identified himself as such — pursuing his constitutional duty to conduct oversight — to ask Secretary Kristi Noem a question, was assaulted and thrown to the floor.
And then secondly, what is also deeply alarming is that the Department of Homeland Security, under Secretary Kristi Noem, has gone to the public and lied on record saying that he did _**not_** identify himself — when there is video evidence that they are being dishonest with the American people.
There must be a retraction. **We must have an investigation of what just happened**.
This is a deeply alarming escalation in the violence of the Trump administration.
They have unleashed chaos in Los Angeles by violently raiding and ripping apart peaceful public spaces. Now they’re tackling and arresting sitting members of Congress, while going on the record and lying about what happened.
This is an out of control agency and there must be consequences.
For an administration that has talked about free speech, the First Amendment, “respect for the rule of law” — we are seeing that they are threatening judges, openly talking about punishing Supreme Court Justices, and egregiously indicting members of Congress on baseless allegations.
This is all coming down — not to the facts, not to crime, not to the law — but to political intimidation.
**We will not be intimidated**. We will not be silenced. If they want to come in and arrest every member of Congress, they can come and get us.
But at some point, the Republican-held United States Senate needs to decide what is an impeachable offense.
Because at a certain point, it will not be about Democrats and Republicans — they will start going after Republican Senators who do not do what they want.
We do not have to comply with illegal activity — even if that illegal activity is coming from the President of the United States.

In solidarity,
Alexandria

name: GIFFORDS Alert
subject: Trump is holding a military parade on his birthday.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
We must speak out.
#

Team,
In case you haven’t heard, Donald Trump is preparing to hold a government-funded military parade on his 79th birthday this Saturday.
According to NBC News, the event will have more than 9,000 soldiers, 130 military vehicles, 50 helicopters, and eight Army bands in attendance. All of this to stroke the president’s ego.
The price tag? Up to $45 million in taxpayer dollars.
This comes at the same time the Trump administration stripped millions of dollars in school mental health resources and removed grants from community violence intervention programs -- things that we KNOW help prevent violence.
Donald Trump is sending a clear message: He would rather spend your money celebrating himself than solving issues that help our families. **This is wrong, and we have to speak out now.**
[**Add your name to tell Congress that you are AGAINST Donald Trump spending taxpayer money for a military parade for himself this weekend. body:
This is not a drill

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2566%2E4032634%2ElQMK-D)
---
This is a horrifying moment in our nation's history. Yesterday, United States Senator Alex Padilla was violently removed from a public briefing for asking questions on behalf of the people he represents. People in California who deserve answers about the brutal crackdown on protesters. I've watched the video, as many of you have as well. Let me just describe what it shows. Officers pushed Senator Padilla backwards out of the room as he said the words, “I am Senator Padilla. I have questions for the Secretary.” He was then shoved to the ground. When the Senator complied with the officers and went on his knees, he was forcibly pinned onto his stomach. He was ordered to put his hands behind his back. He can be heard on the video saying he is trying to comply with their orders. Officers then put handcuffs on the senator while he was lying on the ground. His staff was then told to stop recording the handcuffing. He was put in handcuffs for asking a simple question. He was put in handcuffs for doing his job as a United States Senator. He was put in handcuffs for standing up for the Constitution of the United States. He was put in handcuffs for representing the people of California. Now, if you're not yet convinced that President Trump and his administration are trying to suppress free speech, then just watch the video. If you are not yet convinced that President Trump and his administration are trying to undermine the foundations of our democracy, then watch the video. If you are not yet convinced that President Trump and his administration are hell bent on punishing people with differing opinions than those of the President, then watch the video. And here is the really chilling part. Make no mistake: What happened to Senator Padilla is happening every day all across this country. Every day DHS agents are throwing people to the ground and violently handcuffing them while they are not resisting, detaining them for exercising their First Amendment rights of free speech. Every day Donald Trump is making this nation look more and more like a fascist state. If this is how federal agents treat a United States senator who peacefully asks questions of this administration, then we all have to ask: how far will they go? How violent will they get? I know my Republican colleagues can see what happened was wrong. But will any Republican senator speak up for our democracy? Where are our Republican colleagues? Stand up and speak out. This is a continuation of what we've been seeing: Intimidate every other check on presidential power in this country. Fire the civil service. Get rid of those people. Threaten to imprison judges. Criminally charge House members who try to visit an ice facility. Arrest senators who ask questions. **This is not a drill. This is an assault on our democracy. I am calling on every Republican member of Congress to condemn what happened. I am demanding a bipartisan investigation into this incident. And I’ll continue to raise the alarm about this horrifying moment for our democracy.** Elizabeth

| | The opioid epidemic has devastated families and communities across Northwest Washington, and we cannot afford to wait to act. **That is why I just introduced the PROTECT Act, bipartisan legislation to support Tribal communities in the fight against opioid trafficking. Tribal leaders have been sounding the alarm about the unique challenges they face in stopping the flow of dangerous drugs onto their lands —** and it is time Congress listens. This bill gives Tribes the tools they need to strengthen sovereignty, save lives, and keep their communities safe. **Tribes in my district have shared with me the unique challenges their courts and law enforcement face in holding drug traffickers accountable. The PROTECT Act takes significant steps toward addressing the many concerns I hear.** Tribes across the country have emphasized the need for additional tools and resources to ensure drug traffickers cannot take advantage of jurisdictional loopholes to evade accountability. **This legislation will:**
* Provide parity for Tribal courts to issue search warrants for certain electronic communications, including social media, by adding Tribal courts to the list of courts with "competent jurisdiction" under the Stored Communications Act.
* Expand Special Tribal Criminal Jurisdiction to crimes associated with drug trafficking.
* Amend the Bureau of Prisons' Tribal Prisoner Program by expanding eligibility to offenders who commit drug-trafficking-related offenses.

This is just one part of the work ahead. I have also reintroduced my full districtwide legislative package to combat the opioid crisis, from holding traffickers accountable to investing in treatment and prevention. **We are seeing signs of progress: Washington state saw an 11% drop in drug overdose deaths last year. But we know the crisis is far from over.** With your support, I will keep working alongside Tribes, local leaders, law enforcement, and public health experts to build on that progress and deliver the solutions our communities urgently need. clean_body: CW: Opioid use, addiction | | | | The opioid epidemic has devastated families and communities across Northwest Washington, and we cannot afford to wait to act. That is why I just introduced the PROTECT Act, bipartisan legislation to support Tribal communities in the fight against opioid trafficking. Tribal leaders have been sounding the alarm about the unique challenges they face in stopping the flow of dangerous drugs onto their lands — and it is time Congress listens. This bill gives Tribes the tools they need to strengthen sovereignty, save lives, and keep their communities safe. Tribes in my district have shared with me the unique challenges their courts and law enforcement face in holding drug traffickers accountable. The PROTECT Act takes significant steps toward addressing the many concerns I hear. Tribes across the country have emphasized the need for additional tools and resources to ensure drug traffickers cannot take advantage of jurisdictional loopholes to evade accountability. This legislation will: Provide parity for Tribal courts to issue search warrants for certain electronic communications, including social media, by adding Tribal courts to the list of courts with "competent jurisdiction" under the Stored Communications Act. Expand Special Tribal Criminal Jurisdiction to crimes associated with drug trafficking. Amend the Bureau of Prisons' Tribal Prisoner Program by expanding eligibility to offenders who commit drug-trafficking-related offenses. This is just one part of the work ahead. I have also reintroduced my full districtwide legislative package to combat the opioid crisis, from holding traffickers accountable to investing in treatment and prevention. We are seeing signs of progress: Washington state saw an 11% drop in drug overdose deaths last year. But we know the crisis is far from over. With your support, I will keep working alongside Tribes, local leaders, law enforcement, and public health experts to build on that progress and deliver the solutions our communities urgently need. We have to keep fighting — together. body:

Hey, Derek, it’s John.

Unless you’re one of Trump’s rich besties, the “Big Beautiful Bill” is TERRIBLE.
_Why?_ Lemme break it down. Here’s why Trump’s budget is a dumpster fire for working families:
**1\. Nearly 300K Pennsylvanians could *lose* Medicaid coverage.** These folks – cancer patients, seniors in nursing homes, low-income kids – will be kicked off their health care so Trump’s rich pals can get *another* tax break.
**2\. It’ll jack up energy bills.** Families in PA could see energy costs rise by up to $1,200 a year. I don't know about you, but that $1,200 should be covering rent or groceries, not lining the pockets of oil executives.
**3\. It guts domestic manufacturing.** The GOP wants to roll back tax credits that support American-made jobs – we’d lose $50 billion in investments and risk sending these jobs overseas. It’s ridiculous.
I’m a hard NO on this bill. But if we’re going to keep up this fight to stop it in the Senate, I need this grassroots team by my side. So I'm personally asking: **[Will you toss in $5 today to help us hit our $15,000 mid-month goal and fight to protect Medicaid, good jobs, and working families across PA?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/50993?refcode=jtk126-fr-fl&t=1&akid=10144%2E434096%2EPc0_r8)**

Peter, we need to keep talking about Ohio.
This year, Ohio lawmakers will lead the process of redrawing their congressional map. This is significant because some politicians in Ohio have stopped at nothing to manipulate electoral maps to give them a partisan advantage.
**And when we say stop at nothing, we literally mean they’ve stopped at nothing.** In the past decade alone, the Ohio Supreme Court has struck down gerrymandered maps more than once.
They’ve struck them down more than _twice._
And yes, they’ve struck them down more than _three times_.
_The Ohio Supreme Court has struck down the maps drawn by Ohio legislators a whopping**SEVEN** times._
**This is exactly why All On The Line is focusing on Ohio this year — educating and mobilizing people on the ground to stand strong against threats to our free and fair elections.**

name: Eric Sorensen
subject: [PHOTOS] Join me in IL-17
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109529118/551396579/-1812448514?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGIzZjAzZi03YTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntrO7W6IAtumPQ3dhQ7BoR5AedSoh5mL81ZHpXxpPn0=)
Peter, Sometimes it’s nice to get away from Washington and back home, where folks work hard to find solutions for each other – a far cry from the politics you’d imagine by watching the bluster on social media and cable “news.” It’s not easy in this environment of hate and division that extremists promote, but we have to always keep focus on the ones doing the work, not those yelling the loudest. Below are some highlights from events over the past month that I wanted to share. But first and foremost, I want to thank you, Peter. Your support allows me to support these people in making real, meaningful change. And I’m confident that if we keep going, we can bring that spirit of meaningful, working-class change back to Washington. -Eric | [Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109529119/551396580/-1812448514?refcode=em-6.13.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGIzZjAzZi03YTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntrO7W6IAtumPQ3dhQ7BoR5AedSoh5mL81ZHpXxpPn0=)
---
* * *
**I was able to meet up with newly-elected Rock Island Mayor Ashley Harris to discuss his vision and how we can work together for the benefit of all in Rock Island.** Congratulations to Mayor Harris for earning the privilege of serving our homes.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109529120/551396581/-1812448514?refcode=em-6.13.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGIzZjAzZi03YTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntrO7W6IAtumPQ3dhQ7BoR5AedSoh5mL81ZHpXxpPn0=)
**I saw firsthand how The Good Food Pantry in Macomb served families with dignity—and why we must protect SNAP benefits.** In challenging times, places like these are essential. Thank you to everyone volunteering on the frontlines to tackle food insecurity in Western Illinois.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109529121/551396582/-1812448514?refcode=em-6.13.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGIzZjAzZi03YTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntrO7W6IAtumPQ3dhQ7BoR5AedSoh5mL81ZHpXxpPn0=)
**It was great to visit Green Current Solutions in East Moline—a small business doing big things for sustainability.** I’m proud to stand with CEO Tammy Becker and support their model for innovation as well as women-owned business in the heart of the Quad Cities!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109529122/551396583/-1812448514?refcode=em-6.13.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGIzZjAzZi03YTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntrO7W6IAtumPQ3dhQ7BoR5AedSoh5mL81ZHpXxpPn0=)
**It was nice to meet up with Galesburg Mayor Peter Schwartzman at Judy’s Family Cafe in Galesburg—full plates, good conversation, and even better company!** We talked about new projects in the work for Knox County and how we can work together to get the job done. It’s always a good day when it starts with pancakes and partnership!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109529123/551396584/-1812448514?refcode=em-6.13.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGIzZjAzZi03YTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntrO7W6IAtumPQ3dhQ7BoR5AedSoh5mL81ZHpXxpPn0=)
**And I got to appreciate the water on Mississippi River Day!** I am thankful to be able to represent the people along our nation’s greatest river. While most Members of Congress search somewhere around the world for their favorite beach, mine is right here. No place I would rather be.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109529124/551396585/-1812448514?refcode=em-6.13.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGIzZjAzZi03YTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntrO7W6IAtumPQ3dhQ7BoR5AedSoh5mL81ZHpXxpPn0=)
I’m so grateful to everyone in the district, and it’s the highlight of serving my community to meet my neighbors of IL-17 where they are.
[**We have a major FEC deadline coming up at the end of June. If you can, chip in a $3 grassroots contribution to help flip the Midwest blue and bring our community-first spirit to the majority in Congress.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109529125/551396586/-1812448514?refcode=em-6.13.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGIzZjAzZi03YTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntrO7W6IAtumPQ3dhQ7BoR5AedSoh5mL81ZHpXxpPn0=)

clean_body: | = Peter, Sometimes it’s nice to get away from Washington and back home, where folks work hard to find solutions for each other – a far cry from the politics you’d imagine by watching the bluster on social media and cable “news.” It’s not easy in this environment of hate and division that extremists promote, but we have to always keep focus on the ones doing the work, not those yelling the loudest. Below are some highlights from events over the past month that I wanted to share. But first and foremost, I want to thank you, Peter. Peter — For campaigns like ours, June can be make-or-break. At the end of this month, we’re legally required to report our fundraising numbers for the entire quarter to the Federal Election Commission (FEC). After we submit our report, it will be publicly available. This means _everyone_ — including far-right special interest groups and GOP megadonors — will be able to see how much we raised and judge the strength of our grassroots team. _How many people chipped in? Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? | | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Happy Friday,
As we gear up for the Mountain Majesty Gala on June 21st, we want to give a special shoutout to our **Platinum Sponsors** today. These businesses are _bold, unapologetic, and aligned with our values_ —TRUTH, freedom, and the American spirit.
✨ [Adam J. Yormack, Esq.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
✨ [CLE Cigar Company](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
✨ [Exectras](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

We’re deeply thankful for the rest of our incredible sponsor family who helped make this evening a reality. We encourage our readers to stand behind businesses!

We couldn’t do this without the incredible community rallying behind us. **[Get your tickets before it's too late!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[GET YOUR TICKET HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Lots of news today... We encourage you to check out the website so you don't miss a thing. Also, listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Denver ranks [fifth worst nationwide](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for inflation. At the Capitol, Democrats passed [12 new gun laws](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—one of the state’s toughest crackdowns yet. The DOJ is now seeking access to Colorado’s 2020 and 2024 voter data, challenging [claims of election security](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). In Morgan County, Rep. Boebert is addressing [contaminated drinking water](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while CPW faces backlash for sidelining ranchers on [wolf policy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). And in a landmark move, Colorado Springs D11 now requires student-athletes to compete by [biological sex](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
🇺🇸 **On the National Stage...** Nationally, chaos erupted in L.A. as leftist groups and unions like SEIU allegedly [coordinated protests](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) that turned violent, prompting an FBI probe into funding sources. Meanwhile, Israel launched a [precision strike on Iran’s nuclear program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) despite Trump’s warnings, raising fears of retaliation as U.S.-Iran talks hang in the balance.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** From Colorado’s law [criminalizing “misgendering”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to media spin [labeling riots as “peaceful protests,”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) writers warn of growing attacks on speech, truth, and constitutional rights. As [Trump’s policies quietly succeed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), critics shift to distraction and disruption. Some, like Dale Parker, call for bold action—proposing a [national citizen militia](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to defend against tyranny at home.
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, June 13, 2025.
– Team RMV
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[From real estate to crypto to Colorado: Eric Trump to speak at RMV Mountain Majesty Gala](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
They didn’t want this event to happen. Activists have spent weeks pressuring the venue, trying to intimidate organizers into pulling the plug. But the Rocky Mountain Voice’s first Mountain Majesty Gala is moving forward – and Eric Trump is headlining it.
His June 21 appearance comes as conservatives in Colorado work to turn energy into strategy – and frustration into action.
While his last name still dominates headlines, Trump arrives not just as a surrogate – but as a strategist, builder and global voice for strength, sovereignty and innovation. With protest threats in the background, and momentum from the base up front, the Gala is already doing what it set out to do: make waves.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[DOJ requests Colorado’s 2020 and 2024 voter data—Griswold’s ‘Gold Standard’ gets tested](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX 31 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The U.S. Department of Justice has requested all records related to Colorado’s 2024 federal election and asked the state to preserve records from 2020.
* Secretary of State Jena Griswold criticized the request, claiming it would fuel “disinformation” despite previously touting Colorado’s elections as the national “gold standard.”
* The move comes as the DOJ also attempts to intervene in the legal case of former Mesa County clerk Tina Peters, who was convicted after giving access to election machines following the 2020 vote.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[D-11 school board votes to adopt policy requiring sports participation based on biological sex](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Springs’ District 11 school board voted 6-1 to adopt a policy requiring students to participate in sports based on biological sex, joining a growing movement to restore fairness in school athletics.
* The new rule also ensures that locker rooms and hotel accommodations align with students’ biological sex, reinforcing safety and privacy—especially for female athletes.
* Supporters applauded the board for standing up to political pressure and protecting the integrity of girls’ sports in the face of ongoing nationwide debate.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Parker: We need a national, armed citizen militia now](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY DALE PARKER****| COMMENTARY | JUNE 12** _I am not surprised at the result of the efforts of people in our state to banish firearms. No one should be surprised at the open contempt for our God given rights, protected in our Bill of Rights, that was demonstrated by requiring Ken DeGraaf to cover part of our Constitution._
__
**[Garbo: The Left’s silence says more than their spin ever could](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY C. J. GARBO | COMMENTARY | JUNE 12** _They don’t talk about egg prices anymore. Inflation has disappeared from their daily talking points. You’ll hear nothing about tariffs, the stock market, or the border crisis they once screamed about nonstop. Why?_
__
**[Hancock: The phrase that shields tyranny behind a slogan](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY MICHAEL HANCOCK | COMMENTARY | JUNE 12** _In George Orwell’s 1984, citizens were told that war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength. It was called Newspeak—language engineered to distort thought—and doublethink, the act of believing two contradictory things at once._

This is appalling, friend.

**Instead of receiving answers, he was escorted out in handcuffs. I stand with the Senator and with anyone who is seeking accountability for the Trump Administration’s actions.**

And the troubling news doesn’t stop there: Tomorrow, on his birthday, Donald Trump is holding a military parade in our nation’s capitol – costing taxpayers upwards of $45 million.

It’s a _slap in the face_ to struggling families in IL-13 and beyond. This Administration will rip away Medicaid funding one day, then spend millions on an unnecessary show of military might the next.

It’s important that we stay engaged, not silenced by the battles ahead. It’s why I’m already focused on keeping this seat blue next year so Democrats have a fighting chance to flip the House majority.

body:
If this is how those in power respond when challenged in public by a legislator, consider what they’re capable of doing to ordinary citizens when the cameras aren’t rolling.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109531125/551403727/2140832878?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNWE3ZjY0NC03ZjQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nKD5_Icraar_2GuJjwARpK443Pb7WaVfZ0Z0itOMdS0=&emci=1d31d6e5-5848-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=35a7f644-7f48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=9818364)
---

| | Yesterday, my colleague Alex Padilla sought to question a public official about the Trump administration's actions that are impacting his constituents in California — _he was doing the foundational job of oversight that we elect Senators to do._ **Trump and Kristi Noem's thugs responded by roughing him up, forcing him to the ground, and handcuffing him.** If this is how those in power respond when challenged in public by a legislator, _consider what they're capable of doing to ordinary citizens – or anyone else – when the cameras aren't rolling._ What happened yesterday must be roundly condemned. Kristi Noem must be held accountable. And we in the Senate must not give an inch in ceding our constitutional authority when an out-of-control executive branch starts ignoring the basic rule of law. More soon, _Ron_ |

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109531227/551404126/2026934182?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MM1_250613_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDIyNDE4YS03ZjQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EjEM5O9K1GJel2ytTggGvm6QQe8z5azUpeWoRSXiies=) Derek,

Tomorrow, the Trump administration is hosting its “Grand Military Parade” – all bankrolled by hardworking taxpayers.

**Let’s call it what it is: a self-indulgent birthday bash for Donald Trump and an unacceptable politicization of our military.**

And it’s another reminder that we need a Senate that will put a check on this reckless administration.

If that’s all you need to hear, I’m asking you to chip in today – ahead of my mid-month fundraising deadline – to support my reelection campaign so I can continue the fight to hold the Trump administration accountable: [_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mw-email-250612-mm**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109531228/551404129/2026934182?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MM1_250613_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDIyNDE4YS03ZjQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EjEM5O9K1GJel2ytTggGvm6QQe8z5azUpeWoRSXiies=) Now, let’s get the facts straight, Derek:

Trump has fired:
* VA employees
* Top national security officials
* Folks that screen miners for black lung
* Researchers preventing kids from getting addicted to tobacco

And now he thinks a birthday parade that will inconvenience thousands of Virginians is a good use of taxpayer money? America has the most sophisticated, accomplished, and advanced military in the world. We don’t need a parade to show off – we need thoughtful investments in preparing for the next generation of national security and in the needs of our servicemembers.

**Of course, my Republican colleagues _still_ remain silent.**

If we want to reign in the chaos, corruption, and mismanagement from this administration, we need to flip the Senate blue.

[_**That’s why I’m asking: will you pitch in today so we can reach our $25,000 mid-month fundraising goal, protect my seat, and take back the Senate majority for Democrats?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109531230/551404132/2026934182?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MM1_250613_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDIyNDE4YS03ZjQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EjEM5O9K1GJel2ytTggGvm6QQe8z5azUpeWoRSXiies=)

The fight continues,

Mark Warner

name: Office of U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks
subject: Senator Alsobrooks Newsletter -- June 13
body:
|

---
Dear friends and neighbors, I'm sure you saw the breathtaking encounter that occurred yesterday between federal officials and my colleague Senator Alex Padilla. Senator Padilla - who had been escorted to the press briefing by federal agents - was manhandled, forced out of a room, taken to the ground, and handcuffed by agents in a federal building yesterday. All for asking a question on behalf of the citizens who elected him. This is not the America that we know and love. There are some who are saying they don't recognize this America. And I want to ring the bell today for everyone right now: We have now crossed a line. Yesterday was a dangerous day in the history of our country. In Donald Trump's America, asking a question and pushing back caused him to be manhandled for the whole world to see. Manhandled. Treated like a person who had come off the streets. The thuggish behavior that I saw is absolutely unacceptable. A peaceful man - who is not only a senator, but, a father, a husband, a person, a venerable part of our society - was there on behalf of the people who have elected him - was treated violently. He had his hands in the air, and apparently that wasn't enough. If this attack on a U.S. Senator doesn't make you shudder, then I have no words. Because yesterday it was Senator Padilla. Tomorrow it could be any person who disagrees with this Administration - whether a federal official elected by the people of this great nation, or an educator who voices their concern with the future of our children's education. This is NOT what democracy looks like. This is anything but a democracy. The right to free speech is sacred in our country. And if we as a country continue along this road -- we will account for it. The people who perpetrated these violent acts must be held accountable, and the American people cannot and will not be silenced. You can watch my remarks on the senate floor [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14289.9493721.5432685.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fx.com%2fSen_Alsobrooks%2fstatus%2f1933260673083191511&redir_log=22055926578332).
**Sick of It** Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. continues to make dangerous decisions when it comes to leading the premier medical research agencies in the world. He's making decisions that are not in the best interest of the American people, and he's quite literally making us sicker. Let's look at the facts: $15 million in cuts to cancer research grants $9.5 billion in NIH grants terminated 20,000 jobs eliminated And just this week, we see that RFK Jr. won't even honor his promises to my colleagues on the other side of the aisle. After saying he would not change the CDC Advisory Committee for Immunization Practices, he fired all 17 members. And who did he replace them with? Anti-vax conspiracy theorists who will undoubtedly rubber stamp his anti-vax agenda. I have already called for RFK Jr. to resign or be fired. I took a resolution to the floor for unanimous consent last month and Republicans blocked it. I hope they too can see the danger that lies ahead if we don't act now. Click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14289.9493721.5432685.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fx.com%2fSen_Alsobrooks%2fstatus%2f1932805000515764438&redir_log=509398361715332) to see my conversation with Lawrence O'Donnell on Tuesday night. **Fighting for Your Health Care** I am proud to share that I introduced the Medicare and Medicaid Dental, Vision and Hearing Benefit Act. The introduction of my legislation was part of an effort by more than a dozen of my Democratic colleagues in the Senate to strengthen and invest in Medicaid - especially at a time when our colleagues on the other side of the aisle are trying to slash it. Specifically, the bill would: \- Amend the Social Security Act to include Medicare coverage for routine cleanings, exams, fillings, crowns, root canals, extractions, emergency care, hearing aids, eye exams, and more, phased in gradually to 80% coverage. \- Encourage states to provide their optional dental, hearing, and vision services to people with Medicaid by increasing the associated Federal Medical Assistance Percentage (FMAP) rate to 90 percent. This legislation is very personal to me and to our state. 18 years ago, a young Marylander named Deamonte Driver died of complications from a tooth infection because his family was kicked off Medicaid and could not afford the care they needed. He was only 12 years old. Senator Cardin worked tirelessly throughout his career to make sure that no child should ever suffer Deamonte's fate. Every child, every family, deserves access to quality, affordable dental care. Access is literally a matter of life and death. This bill builds upon Senator Cardin's work and continues to expand and strengthen Medicaid dental, hearing, and vision coverage. While this Administration and its supporters in Congress are determined to kick as many people off their health insurance as possible, we will fight tooth and nail to expand coverage and to ensure that every American, every child in particular, has access to the care they need. You can read more in a Baltimore Sun article [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14289.9493721.5432685.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.baltimoresun.com%2f2025%2f06%2f12%2fmaryland-senators-join-dems-on-medicaid-bills-as-republicans-consider-cuts%2f&redir_log=432272415322795). **Fighting for First Responders** As you may know, we lost two Baltimore City firefighters in recent weeks and it's clear that more needs to be done to ensure our firefighters have the resources they need to stay safe and combat mental health challenges that come from the trauma of their jobs. During a confirmation hearing this week, I demanded answers from OSHA Nominee David Keeling and pushed for a commitment to quickly finalize the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Emergency Response Standard. OSHA is proposing an update to workplace protections for firefighters and other emergency service personnel, which has not been updated for nearly 50 years. The standard calls for increased safety standards in emergency response, including staffing, training, apparatus readiness, and protective clothing and equipment. Additionally, it will require employers to obtain baseline medical screenings for all emergency responders and requires access to behavioral health resources. At the same time, this Administration has taken actions that together make firefighters and emergency responders less safe.
* RFK Jr. cut staff from the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health, or NIOSH, the health agency responsible for overseeing workplace safety.
* Those staffing cuts forced the National Firefighter Cancer Registry to go offline, leaving firefighters who suffer from toxic exposure and heightened cancer risks in the lurch.
* The Administration abruptly paused training at the National Fire Academy in Emmitsburg, Maryland earlier this year, saying that the government would not pay for travel for programs it did not deem mission critical.

Watch part of my questioning for OSHA Nominee David Keeling [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14289.9493721.5432685.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fx.com%2fSen_Alsobrooks%2fstatus%2f1930671847747514426&redir_log=45689376421333). **Fighting Through Legislation** I continue to work hard to fight for Marylanders. From fighting for the safety of our first responders to fighting to ensure each of us has access to the health care we need, I wanted to share some of the legislation I cosponsored over the last week.
Expanded Coverage for Former Foster Youth Act This bill aims to ensure continuity of health insurance for youth who have left foster care. It extends Medicaid coverage for eligible youth until the age of 26, regardless of their previous Medicaid enrollment status or if they were in a different state's foster care system. The Act also mandates that states establish outreach and enrollment programs to help these youth access their Medicaid benefits. Easy Enrollment in Health Care Act This bill would simplify the process of enrolling in a health insurance plan by enabling Americans to receive health care plan information and enroll in coverage through their federal income tax returns. Stabilize Medicaid and CHIP Coverage Act This bill would provide 12 months of continuous coverage for all individuals receiving health care through Medicaid or the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP), so that they do not risk losing coverage during that period of time. Helping Tobacco Users Quit Act This bill would extend comprehensive tobacco cessation coverage to all Medicaid and CHIP beneficiaries, as well as eliminate cost sharing and prior authorization requirements. Protect IVF Act This bill seeks to establish a federal statutory right for individuals to access, providers to offer, and insurers to cover fertility treatments, particularly in vitro fertilization (IVF), without interference from state-level restrictions that are not grounded in evidence-based medical standards. My Body, My Data Act This bill seeks to establish a national privacy standard to safeguard personal reproductive and sexual health data. Specifically, it limits the collection and use of such data to what is strictly necessary for delivering a requested product or service, helping to prevent its misuse, sale, or exposure, particularly by non-HIPAA-covered entities like apps, websites, and tech platforms. clean_body: | Dear friends and neighbors, I'm sure you saw the breathtaking encounter that occurred yesterday between federal officials and my colleague Senator Alex Padilla. Senator Padilla - who had been escorted to the press briefing by federal agents - was manhandled, forced out of a room, taken to the ground, and handcuffed by agents in a federal building yesterday. All for asking a question on behalf of the citizens who elected him. This is not the America that we know and love. There are some who are saying they don't recognize this America. And I want to ring the bell today for everyone right now: We have now crossed a line. Yesterday was a dangerous day in the history of our country. In Donald Trump's America, asking a question and pushing back caused him to be manhandled for the whole world to see. Manhandled. Treated like a person who had come off the streets. The thuggish behavior that I saw is absolutely unacceptable. A peaceful man - who is not only a senator, but, a father, a husband, a person, a venerable part of our society - was there on behalf of the people who have elected him - was treated violently. He had his hands in the air, and apparently that wasn't enough. If this attack on a U.S. Senator doesn't make you shudder, then I have no words. Because yesterday it was Senator Padilla. Tomorrow it could be any person who disagrees with this Administration - whether a federal official elected by the people of this great nation, or an educator who voices their concern with the future of our children's education. This is NOT what democracy looks like. This is anything but a democracy. The right to free speech is sacred in our country. And if we as a country continue along this road -- we will account for it. The people who perpetrated these violent acts must be held accountable, and the American people cannot and will not be silenced. You can watch my remarks on the senate floor . Sick of It Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. continues to make dangerous decisions when it comes to leading the premier medical research agencies in the world. He's making decisions that are not in the best interest of the American people, and he's quite literally making us sicker. Let's look at the facts: $15 million in cuts to cancer research grants $9.5 billion in NIH grants terminated 20,000 jobs eliminated And just this week, we see that RFK Jr. won't even honor his promises to my colleagues on the other side of the aisle. After saying he would not change the CDC Advisory Committee for Immunization Practices, he fired all 17 members. And who did he replace them with? Anti-vax conspiracy theorists who will undoubtedly rubber stamp his anti-vax agenda. I have already called for RFK Jr. to resign or be fired. I took a resolution to the floor for unanimous consent last month and Republicans blocked it. I hope they too can see the danger that lies ahead if we don't act now. Click to see my conversation with Lawrence O'Donnell on Tuesday night. Fighting for Your Health Care I am proud to share that I introduced the Medicare and Medicaid Dental, Vision and Hearing Benefit Act. The introduction of my legislation was part of an effort by more than a dozen of my Democratic colleagues in the Senate to strengthen and invest in Medicaid - especially at a time when our colleagues on the other side of the aisle are trying to slash it. Specifically, the bill would: \- Amend the Social Security Act to include Medicare coverage for routine cleanings, exams, fillings, crowns, root canals, extractions, emergency care, hearing aids, eye exams, and more, phased in gradually to 80% coverage. \- Encourage states to provide their optional dental, hearing, and vision services to people with Medicaid by increasing the associated Federal Medical Assistance Percentage (FMAP) rate to 90 percent. This legislation is very personal to me and to our state. 18 years ago, a young Marylander named Deamonte Driver died of complications from a tooth infection because his family was kicked off Medicaid and could not afford the care they needed. He was only 12 years old. Senator Cardin worked tirelessly throughout his career to make sure that no child should ever suffer Deamonte's fate. Every child, every family, deserves access to quality, affordable dental care. Access is literally a matter of life and death. This bill builds upon Senator Cardin's work and continues to expand and strengthen Medicaid dental, hearing, and vision coverage. While this Administration and its supporters in Congress are determined to kick as many people off their health insurance as possible, we will fight tooth and nail to expand coverage and to ensure that every American, every child in particular, has access to the care they need. You can read more in a Baltimore Sun article . Fighting for First Responders As you may know, we lost two Baltimore City firefighters in recent weeks and it's clear that more needs to be done to ensure our firefighters have the resources they need to stay safe and combat mental health challenges that come from the trauma of their jobs. OSHA is proposing an update to workplace protections for firefighters and other emergency service personnel, which has not been updated for nearly 50 years. The standard calls for increased safety standards in emergency response, including staffing, training, apparatus readiness, and protective clothing and equipment. Additionally, it will require employers to obtain baseline medical screenings for all emergency responders and requires access to behavioral health resources. At the same time, this Administration has taken actions that together make firefighters and emergency responders less safe. RFK Jr. cut staff from the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health, or NIOSH, the health agency responsible for overseeing workplace safety. Peter –
Donald Trump’s so-called “Big, Beautiful Bill” isn’t just about tax breaks for the wealthy — it’s about ripping away health care from those who need it most.
The bill includes deep cuts to Medicaid and Medicare – threatening the health of seniors, children, people with disabilities, and working families across Colorado. Jena knows what’s at stake — she grew up in a working-class family that relied on food stamps to get by.
It’s a cruel trade: tax breaks for billionaires paid for by taking health care from the most vulnerable.

name: MassDems
subject: What the “Big Beautiful Bill” Really Means for Massachusetts
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Peter,
We need to talk about the so-called “One Big Beautiful” tax bill that passed the House and is now with the Senate. Despite the name, there’s very little 'beautiful' about what this bill will do to Massachusetts.
Here’s what’s on the line:
SNAP (Food Stamps) — A Lifeline Cut
Roughly 250,000 Massachusetts residents —many of them children—stand to lose some or all of their SNAP benefits. (Mass Law Reform Institute via the Boston Globe)
Parents with children over six and grandparents under 65 would be required to work, train, or perform community service 20 hours/week to qualify beyond three months.
These requirements don’t consider real barriers like lack of child care and transportation.
Massachusetts would have to absorb new costs , with $710 million in additional annual burden , according to Project Bread and Boston Globe reporting.
SNAP currently contributes over $2.6 billion annually to our state economy , supporting over 5,500 local farmers and countless retailers.
Health Care — Gutted
The Governor’s office warns of a $1.75 billion cut to our state’s health care system . (mass.gov)
That means 250,000 families, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities losing coverage.
Expect closures or major service cuts to community health centers, hospitals, and nursing homes.
Health care workers— doctors and nurses —will lose jobs.
More uninsured patients will flood ERs, driving up costs for everyone.
As Gov. Maura Healey put it: “This isn’t a scalpel to trim waste – this is a massive ax to our entire health care system.”
The Process Was as Ugly as the Bill
Passed 215-214 , with only two Republicans voting ‘no’ and one voting “present.”
It’s a reconciliation bill —meaning it can’t be filibustered and got pushed through with just 20 hours of debate and a “vote-a-rama” frenzy for amendments.
Who Wins, Who Loses
According to the Congressional Budget Office (Boston Globe, 5/24):
Households in the bottom 10% will lose 2–4% of resources , mainly due to cuts in Medicaid and SNAP.
Households in the top 10% will gain 2–4% , primarily from tax breaks.
And when asked if he could guarantee that Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security wouldn’t be touched, Trump responded:
“I have said it so many times, you shouldn’t be asking me that question... We’re not going to touch it. Now, we are going to look for fraud.” (ABC News)
Let’s be clear:
This bill takes food from our poorest kids and health care from our most vulnerable neighbors—all while padding tax cuts for the wealthiest. And in the face of protests over deadly consequences, a U.S. Senator replied: “We all are going to die.” (Sen. Joni Ernst, NPR, May 31)
We cannot afford to sit this one out. The Senate must hear loud and clear from Massachusetts:
We reject this bill. We reject its cruelty. And we stand ready to fight back.
Standing with you,
The MassDems Team
Take Action: Join the No Kings Rally Near You
As we face growing threats to our democracy and the return of authoritarian rhetoric on the national stage, it's more important than ever that we make our voices heard. That’s why we’re encouraging all local committees to promote and participate in the No Kings Rally happening in communities across Massachusetts and beyond.
These rallies are a powerful opportunity to stand up for democratic values, speak out against the dangerous idea of unchecked executive power, and remind the country that no one is above the law.
Find the rally nearest to your community here [https://www.nokings.org/#map]
While we strongly encourage passionate participation, please remember: how we protest matters. Opponents will look for any image or clip that can be taken out of context to portray this movement as un-American or extreme. Let’s prove them wrong by showing up with strength, unity, and respect.
Thank you for all you do to defend democracy and organize in your communities.

name: Rev. Raphael Warnock
subject: It’s time that we stand up
body:
Peter, it’s Rev.
Raphael Warnock.

We’re in a time of great uncertainty. But it’s been proven time and time
again that when the people exercise our power, things can change for the
better.

Democratic governors like Wes Moore are on the frontlines of our
democracy, holding down the fort to defend our constitutional rights and
protect our hard-won progress. His mission is the same as mine in the
Senate: to stand up for the people no matter what the new administration
may throw our way.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250613-1?refcode=em-20250613-1&refcode2=175_1086043_zaQwcC&akid=175%2E1086043%2EzaQwcC ]Together, Wes and I are fighting for our nation, but we need your help.
Will you chip in $10 or whatever you can today?

It’s never been more important to keep fighting for the better world we
know is possible.

That better world can seem far right now. Tariffs are making prices
skyrocket, bedrock government services like Social Security are under
threat, and new policies are hurting the quality of our children’s
education.

Due process, freedom of speech, and the rights that form the heart of our
nation are being ignored and undermined by the Trump administration.

So now is the time that we stand up. Stand up for ourselves, our
neighbors, our children, and everyone who is in need.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250613-1?refcode=em-20250613-1&refcode2=175_1086043_zaQwcC&akid=175%2E1086043%2EzaQwcC ]That’s the focus of my work in the Senate, and it’s the focus of Wes
Moore’s work as Governor of Maryland too. If you're with us, please chip
in $10 to power our movement today.

Peter, thank
you for all that you do.

In gratitude,

Rev. Raphael Warnock
U.S. Senator from Georgia

body:
| Hi Peter

What happened to Senator Alex Padilla is deeply disturbing — and a warning sign we can’t ignore.

**Video shows Senator Padilla clearly identifying himself as a sitting U.S. Senator — only to be shoved, handcuffed, and silenced by federal agents. His aide was even blocked from recording the incident.**

This is not normal. This is not acceptable. This is not how a democracy operates.

**Let me be clear: what happened to Senator Padilla can happen to any American.** If we fail to speak out now, we risk normalizing the use of force to silence oversight and dissent.

I’m calling on my Republican colleagues to condemn this abuse of power. **We cannot allow political intimidation and authoritarian tactics to take root in our country.**

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jf66n3hvb0v2325u8xsd5fzp1033vl9mhe8oldf9o4ab8mdllk8bl54wfhj211heyu65tmsh46cy5wkcj3aw08z1x0t7kjlyh71rpgx6sjd7o9z0gdrk1coeb35kyqzwd71x2kkc3isgrvq71ifk&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sxt67t&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sxt67t&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sxt67t&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sxt67t&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jf66n3hvb0v2325u8xsd5fzpmz5vdd75zbreak6iutmw2xtjc5hi5ax30r0dtzmgur8ttfic6gwjtaaxc8erygie9jm6himydjim8oxefpebz7o7iavwabl2q0ri38753scjhrxbkk6vj8ttlx9c&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sxt67t&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sxt67t&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Remember when Donald Trump and Robert F. Kennedy Jr. promised to “Make America Healthy Again," Peter? **They lied.** Everything they’ve done since taking office is making us less healthy, sicker, and less prepared to deal with future public health crises. RFK Jr. has fired _thousands_ of public health workers — the people who prevent disease outbreaks, monitor our food safety, conduct critical medical research to find lifesaving cures and treatments for chronic diseases, and more. And he has worked to foster distrust in our public health institutions by relying more on conspiracy theories that he has pushed and profited from for decades than on science and fact. Now more than ever, we need leaders who are willing to stand up to the Trump administration and fight for public health in the United States. That’s Mazie. She’s pushing back against Republican cuts to Medicaid in their disastrous budget bill, and she’s fighting to protect critical funding for the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) to ensure that the agency has the funding it needs to keep us safe. **[While Trump and RFK Jr. are decimating our public health agencies and putting Americans at risk, Mazie is fighting back. Peter, I am so honored to be the official Democratic nominee for governor here in New Jersey. Thank you to everyone who played a part in this victory. I wouldn’t be here without this incredible grassroots team who chipped in, volunteered, and voted.
And we can’t stop now.
We know what we are up against. The general election has begun — and if recent history is any indication, it’s going to be an expensive, hard-fought race decided by a razor-thin margin. **[Will you help us get off to a strong start against Trump’s handpicked Republican nominee by splitting $10 between my campaign and Heartland Patriots today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89627?refcode=em20250613-9007&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9007%2E614464%2E6sHPZx)**

Peter, I was raised to believe that we have an obligation to our community and our country.
It’s why I took my first oath to the Constitution as a teenager when I entered the Naval Academy.
It’s why I spent nearly a decade in the Navy as a helicopter pilot and Russian policy officer.
It’s why I went to law school, and became an outreach and reentry coordinator and a federal prosecutor.
It’s why I first ran for office — flipping a Republican-held congressional seat here in New Jersey that no one thought we could win at the time.
And it’s why, Peter, I’m running to serve as our next governor. It’s too hard to get ahead in New Jersey, and too often, our kids have fewer opportunities than we did. The system feels broken, and Donald Trump’s agenda is only making it worse. I can’t accept that — and as governor, I won’t.
**But the fact is, New Jersey is now a battleground state, and Trump is _already_ campaigning for my opponent, Jack Ciattarelli, a career politician who has promised to pass an abortion ban, defund public schools, and bring DOGE to New Jersey. So, truthfully, we won’t win this race unless we have a strong grassroots team behind us right from the start.**

clean_body: The general election begins now. Peter, I am so honored to be the official Democratic nominee for governor here in New Jersey. Thank you to everyone who played a part in this victory. I wouldn’t be here without this incredible grassroots team who chipped in, volunteered, and voted. And we can’t stop now. We know what we are up against. The general election has begun — and if recent history is any indication, it’s going to be an expensive, hard-fought race decided by a razor-thin margin. Peter, I was raised to believe that we have an obligation to our community and our country. It’s why I took my first oath to the Constitution as a teenager when I entered the Naval Academy. It’s why I spent nearly a decade in the Navy as a helicopter pilot and Russian policy officer. It’s why I went to law school, and became an outreach and reentry coordinator and a federal prosecutor. It’s why I first ran for office — flipping a Republican-held congressional seat here in New Jersey that no one thought we could win at the time. And it’s why, Peter, I’m running to serve as our next governor. It’s too hard to get ahead in New Jersey, and too often, our kids have fewer opportunities than we did. The system feels broken, and Donald Trump’s agenda is only making it worse. I can’t accept that — and as governor, I won’t. But the fact is, New Jersey is now a battleground state, and Trump is already campaigning for my opponent, Jack Ciattarelli, a career politician who has promised to pass an abortion ban, defund public schools, and bring DOGE to New Jersey. So, truthfully, we won’t win this race unless we have a strong grassroots team behind us right from the start. # [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109537195/551425181/-896966196?refcode=AU_SMP_FR_GEN_GEN_AC30_20250613_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjdmN2MyNi04YjQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ylSriyk39D20XajB7x_zmUEzXywE1xZHS4nseJo5zso=)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109537196/551425182/2034376778?refcode=AU_SMP_FR_GEN_GEN_AC30_20250613_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjdmN2MyNi04YjQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ylSriyk39D20XajB7x_zmUEzXywE1xZHS4nseJo5zso=) I’ve been in politics a long damn time. I’ve heard a lot of nonsense. But what Senator Joni Ernst just said? That was a first for me. When she was asked about cuts to Medicaid and SNAP and how they’d kill people, her answer was: _**“Well, we’re all going to die.”**_ You just can’t make this stuff up. These Republicans have stopped even _pretending_ to care. They’re slashing health care, kicking folks off food assistance, and when people call them out for the real-life harm they’re causing, their response is basically: _Tough luck, you’re gonna die anyway._ Let me tell you what this is really about: Trump and his buddies in Congress are pushing a so-called “Big Beautiful Bill” that gives away billions in tax cuts to billionaires — and pays for it by ripping health care away from 10.9 million Americans. You read that right. Ten. Point. Nine. Million. And the kicker? That bill will still add $2.4 trillion to the national deficit. They’re not even pretending this is about “fiscal responsibility” anymore. Now they're just committing theft in broad daylight. Look, I know you’re busy. But this is serious. **What’s at stake with the Big Beautiful Bill?**| In South Carolina alone, 1.1 million people rely upon Medicaid or CHIP for healthcare while 581,000 South Carolinians rely upon SNAP for daily food purchases.

Congressional GOP members voted to strip away funding for these critical programs — all for billionaires in this country to receive tax cuts. The Upstate’s very own [Ralph Norman fell asleep during the budget hearing, and then cast the deciding vote](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=4c58e7bbc5&e=edbde6c9b1) on this “Big, Beautiful Bill.”
The time is now. [**Call your senators**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=90eb5d1388&e=edbde6c9b1) and join us in fighting for working-class families across South Carolina. They need to hear from all of us.

body:
That’s how we’re going to win.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109538460/551429207/1219929396?refcode=-header-&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk4MjcyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMwNzI2NWE0LTkwNDgtZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=pyYtWdUWbC8qH-fU67PWZYLYhrZ_x5MkOG7VAk0jImg=) | Peter, If you tuned into WelcomeFest, you heard our Blue Dogs talk about something too often overlooked in politics: **localism.** That’s the key to winning tough, rural, red-to-blue districts — just like the ones Jared Golden, Marie Gluesenkamp Perez, and Adam Gray flipped. These leaders didn’t win by following national talking points. They won by showing up over and over again.
