My Fellow Fighter, I’m writing to you today because I believe you’re an America First Patriot who’s sick of the open borders madness.**** **And that’s exactly who I’m hoping to reach with my _Birthright Citizenship Survey_. ** **[**Would you be able to set aside five minutes to fill out the survey linked here?**](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)** We’re launching a nationwide campaign to educate and activate American patriots on the real intention of Birthright Citizenship... ...and the real disaster it has become for American workers and American citizens. **[And that all starts with this Birthright Citizenship Survey that I’m asking you to complete today.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)** Despite what the mainstream media and too many low-level judges are saying, Birthright Citizenship for tourists and illegal aliens is not written into the Constitution. Rather, the 14th Amendment that contains Birthright Citizenship was enacted to grant full citizenship to the slaves freed by Abraham Lincoln — along with their children and their children’s children. It was not meant to apply to foreign visitors... **And it was _definitely not_ for illegal aliens.** In fact, the text of the 14th Amendment clearly states that it only applies to “persons born or naturalized in the United States, **_AND_** subject to the jurisdiction thereof.” But over time, government bureaucrats stretched the 14th Amendment and automatically gave U.S. citizenship to every birth to illegal aliens, and even to foreign nationals vacationing in the United States. Now, the situation has gotten completely out of hand... **In 2023 alone, there were roughly 350,000 births to illegal aliens in the U.S. Tourists gave birth to another 40,000.** These so-called “anchor babies” can keep illegal alien parents from getting deported and give a legal basis for a whole chain of migrants to push their way into America. Is it any surprise that human traffickers and even high-end birth tourism companies are making billions of dollars? This is not by accident – it’s by design. In fact, the Obama State Department changed U.S. visa rules to explicitly allow women to travel to America for the purpose of giving birth in 2015! Thankfully, the Trump administration overturned this rule and pushed back on illegal immigration on a number of fronts. **_But Trump can’t do it alone._**
---
[ **Take the Survey** ](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)
---
**Fortunately, grassroots organizing is what NumbersUSA does best.** Over the past thirty years, we’ve grown from a small staff into the largest single-issue advocacy group in the United States. Back in 1996, we pioneered the tactic of masses of grassroots voters faxing elected officials directly. In 2007, when Ted Kennedy (remember him?) was trying to grant amnesty to millions of illegal aliens, NumbersUSA mobilized citizens in such numbers that they shut down the Congressional switchboard. The New York Times “blamed” NumbersUSA as the key factor in blocking Kennedy’s decades-long mass amnesty dream. It was a real David-and-Goliath struggle, and we won. Fast forward to 2025, and our populist immigration position is gaining traction in Washington. The DC power brokers are now calling us when they need to mobilize America-First patriots across the country. To be clear, that’s not because they want to talk to me, Roy Beck. It’s because they know that NumbersUSA is the connection point for 8 million members who understand how our immigration system is utterly broken... ...and what it will take to fix it. We’ve never had a President like Donald Trump who gets this issue on such a visceral level. But it takes more than just one man to reverse this open borders insanity. He needs a lot of congressional action to back him up and to make improvements permanent. **In our decades on Capitol Hill, we have learned that nothing grabs attention like fired-up American patriots just like you.** And there’s no denying the impact when a mountain of responses pours in from across the country. It proves that the immigration action we’re calling for isn’t just coming from me and the great folks at NumbersUSA—**no, it’s the unmistakable _DEMAND_ of the American people.** And at that point, a politician doesn’t need one ounce of courage. Just a pinch of common sense will be enough to realize that voting against the American people is a “one-way ticket to Palookaville.” That’s how you take a nationwide network of Patriots and turn it into victories at the ballot box, in Congress, and for generations of Americans to come. That’s what NumbersUSA is all about. We have the experience, we have the playbook, but we need your help to execute on Birthright Citizenship and many other key immigration issues. Since we don’t take a penny from dark money, corrupt NGOs, or the government, we rely on patriots just like you to transform our vision into concrete action. **[**So after you fill out your survey, please make a generous donation of $35, $50, $100 or even as much as $500 or $1,000.**](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)** **If you can’t make a larger donation at this time, I hope you’ll just cover the cost to process your survey—$3.91.** We’ve run enough of these campaigns on Capitol Hill to know that it takes a veritable army of American patriots to get through to these elected officials. And the only way to assemble an army is with a call that goes out all across the nation. **[**Your completed survey and your donation will be an indisputable sign that the time for change has come.**](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)**

| | _**Building a Healthier Indiana and Putting Farmers First**_
---
Friends, Governor Mike Braun dedicated his week to advancing the "Make Indiana Healthy Again" initiative, solidifying Indiana’s reputation as a national leader in responsible health and nutrition policy. Grounded in America First principles and a commitment to Farmers First, Governor Braun continues to champion efforts that prioritize Hoosier agriculture and public health outcomes. On Monday, Governor Braun convened with Secretary Rollins, Secretary Kennedy, Congressman Baird, and Governor Sanders for a strategic discussion focused on restoring the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) to its foundational purpose, promoting nutrition and improving the health of American families. This meeting underscored the Governor’s belief that federal nutrition programs must remain aligned with their core mission: empowering citizens through access to healthy, affordable food. Later in the week, Governor Braun met with Sarah Frey of Frey Farms during a policy session at the America First Policy Institute, where they discussed innovative approaches to expanding access to fresh produce and strengthening market opportunities for Indiana farmers. This partnership reflects the Governor Braun's commitment to elevate rural communities and ensure agriculture remains at the heart of Indiana’s economy and identity. In addition to his work on food and farming, Governor Braun is also taking steps to address one of the most pressing issues in healthcare: the rising cost of prescription drugs. He met with Dr. Mehmet Oz to discuss practical, patient-centered solutions aimed at reducing drug prices and increasing transparency. Indiana is quickly becoming a model for states across the country committed to implementing meaningful public health reform. As always, thank you for being a part of our team. Please feel free to reach out if there's anything I can assist with.

name: Deb Haaland
subject: Two years after Haaland v. Brackeen
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO
body:
We must face hard truths in our pursuit of justice.
# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=2580%2E400544%2ETznGB3)
This weekend marks two years since the Supreme Court issued its ruling in _Haaland v. Brackeen_ , which reaffirmed the constitutionality of ICWA, or the Indian Child Welfare Act.
I feel a deep connection to this case — and not only because I was named as the petitioner. As the Secretary of the Interior, I represented our government and its legal and moral obligation to the 574 federally recognized Native American tribes across our country.
**This case was personal because I am a product of the horrific assimilation policies that ICWA was enacted to finally end.** My maternal grandparents were stolen from their families when they were only eight years old and were forced to live away from their parents, culture, and communities. Many children like them never made it back home.
Over nearly 100 years, tens of thousands of Indigenous children were taken from their communities and forced into boarding schools run by religious institutions and the U.S. government. Many children were doused with DDT upon arrival, and as their coerced re-education got underway, they endured physical abuse for speaking their tribal languages or practicing their traditions.
**But these brutal assimilation practices didn’t end with the closure of the Indian boarding schools – _they evolved_.** In the 1950s and 1960s, Native children were routinely ripped away from their families, tribes, and culture by social workers and placed into non-Native homes through the adoption and foster care system. ICWA was finally passed in 1978 as a direct response to the forced separation of Native children from their families, homes, and culture.
When the Supreme Court voted 7-2 to reaffirm ICWA two years ago, it was a welcome affirmation across Indian Country of what presidents and congressional majorities on both sides of the aisle have recognized for four decades: **Native families belong together.**
It’s so important that we know our history, no matter how painful. I believe we must face hard truths in our pursuit of justice and progress. That’s why I’ve been traveling to every corner of our state to listen to the stories and struggles of working New Mexicans. With every conversation, I feel a renewed sense of hope. Together, we will heal our wounds and enact smart, bold policies that make life better for every family across New Mexico.
[**If you’re with me in this fight, will you make your first $5 contribution to our grassroots campaign for New Mexico? I’m beyond grateful for every ounce of support.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250613_1_brackeen?amount=5&refcode=em20250613-2580&refcode2=2580_400544_TznGB3&akid=2580%2E400544%2ETznGB3)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250613_1_brackeen?amount=5&refcode=em20250613-2580&refcode2=2580_400544_TznGB3&akid=2580%2E400544%2ETznGB3)**
Be fierce,
Deb

## Missed Train Sparks Love Story
On a [six-hour train ride](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOwyAQBdDT2N1EZgyYFBTbpMu2WyIchsAKgwUkUW6_cq6w9Yy-3v8_V3O1McV8_7YbaX_3pvtiMr1aot6pml5tzLVsNt-oxfV4rcW6Xg1OKGCSwGbjbExvw0enPRHSPJJmCz8rLhCnMWimhERGfL3NhH45ExerRM8YJ4tW8THqI22SbMZpkkKdhBLOOibFrBh6twx8Ihd7qaffEnMP5NO7PKmebmUbkw69722Yvwa8DHjZqeyJjtOAl9dhb7CWt6-RsgNPKYFtiWiHkuFTEHqgDC0QbNQhUAX_6I9KEB5ttdkBYwtX7Ixj1W5_xZRikwfqvtmYPoj-7_WeGv8CAAD__8PihnY) from London to Edinburgh in 2000, Maire Clifford decided to pass the time while her then-boyfriend slept by venturing to the train’s smoking carriage. There, she struck up an easy conversation with a fellow traveler, Andy Bain, who’d missed his original train. They exchanged emails, stayed in touch, and eventually reunited. By the time Clifford visited Bain in Edinburgh for New Year’s, he confessed he believed she was his soulmate, even though they’d never even kissed. Bain later proposed at Paddington Station with his grandmother’s ring, and Clifford said yes. They married in 2003 in New Zealand, surrounded by close friends and family. Their story is a perfect example of the butterfly effect—one missed train, one lit cigarette, and a love story for the ages. That chance meeting, Clifford says, made him “believe in fate.”

### What Serbia Did, We Can Do: The Mass-Protest-vs-Trump Era Starts Now
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f1b0dcb2-cfb1-43b1-836f-5904541013d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Donald Trump is throwing himself a birthday parade in Washington, D.C. this Saturday. How cute. We all know how six-year olds like to be celebrated. But Trump's not just throwing any celebration, but a full-blown, authoritarian-style military display, more fitting for Pyongyang than Pennsylvania Avenue.
It's not about patriotism. It's not about the troops. It's all about power. Control. Submission. And if we don't meet this particular moment with **overwhelming** resistance, Trump see this as he should--proof of our lack of stomach for the fight, and a permission slip to take us further into authoritarianism.
**So not only** _**can**_**we meet the moment. We** _**must**._ That's why Americans everywhere will rise tomorrow, June 14, under one rallying cry: **[NO KINGS!](https://substack.com/redirect/5c0d2b17-36f8-41d2-aaad-9216a98acc54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
From coast to coast, peaceful mass protests are planned in hundreds of cities and localities. They're not partisan, they're about defending the Constitution from a carrot-tinted goon who'd sell it on eBay along with Tiffany. Or do to our Constitution what he's done--clearly without its consent--to the American flag.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d7bc6293-cdbe-4587-bf89-edae23553f19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Trump wants the optics of dominance, so we can 't let him have it.** What we need is a tidal wave of democracy. Let's talk some numbers.
One three months ago, over 325,000 Serbians took to the streets (some estimates had this number significantly larger, but we'll use the most cautious one). That was ~5% of their population publicly protesting the authoritarianism of Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić. A right-wing populist who's stripped his citizens of civil rights and attacked the press (sound familiar?). _This was the largest protest in Serbian history_.
If the many Americans feeling hurt, angry, fearful, dismayed and economically wrecked turn out a similar percent of our populace to protest our own rubber-chicken fascist, 17MM Americans would hit the streets. So how about a reasonable and round number? **Let 's get 15 MILLION Americans out tomorrow**. **FIFTEEN MILLION.**
That's you, me and Aunt Mildred. The mother-in-law you argue with about everything but Trump's cocoon of cretin. Your cousin who happens to be in town from Biloxi. Paul, your favorite brother. Fido, who needs a walk anyhow. _All of us. In unison_.
**Making it clear Trump 's dystopia is very much NOT our America**.
This would dwarf Trump's shriveling-mushroom parade in DC with his bone-spurred armored-vehicle brigade. It would show that we're not taking any more of the shit he's unleashed on Los Angeles, Congress and around the world. The moment for this ridiculous roid-rage-like rogue is as over as hair on Stephen Miller's dome.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a6c4ee97-2d96-4302-b0e4-094ac6bef236?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Make no mistake, if we do this right, Trump becomes a lame duck before he even auto-pens the next executive order while losing/cheating at golf. Public pressure of this scale doesn't just shake headlines--it reshapes history.
Congress feels it. The courts feel it. The military feels it. And most importantly, the American people _see each other,_ standing shoulder to shoulder in a shared defense of our freedom. Hell, Mike Johnson might even stop monitoring his son's porn--just for a minute--to take stock of what he's up against.
This is not a protest of despair, my friends. It's a protest of defiance. Of love for country. Of hope. _And of belief in a republic, not a king_.
To repeat a famous anecdote, on the final day of the 1787 Constitutional Convention, when our Constitution was adopted, Americans gathered at Independence Hall in Philadelphia. They were waiting to discover what kind of government our Founding Fathers had created.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f616f2fd-7a62-41eb-b29c-3b520e4c5b29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A prominent socialite and early staple of politics in Philly, Elizabeth Willing Powel, asked Benjamin Franklin, point blank, "What do we have, a republic or a monarchy?" To which Franklin replied, without missing a beat, "A republic, if you can keep it. Our responsibility is to keep it."
**That last line is often forgotten in the retelling,**_**and it 's the most important one**_. It's our responsibility, as it was of those who preceded us, during civil and illegal wars, deportations, raids and voter suppression: To Keep Our Republic.
**We 're not powerless. We have the numbers. We have the moral high ground. And we have the right to assemble.**
If Trump wants tanks, armored trucks and goose-stepping CHUDS for a birthday present his dad forgot every year, then let him have it. We'll give him something much, much better: **Millions of peaceful Americans waving pocket Constitutions,** like lighters in a stadium during a rock ballad. And news coverage of it he can't avoid.
So grab your signs. Print out your rights. Call your neighbors. [Find your nearest #NoKings protest](https://substack.com/redirect/b2ba90b8-6971-48dc-9ade-610d2adf11c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or start one yourself. This isn't about waiting for anybody's permission. It's about using the power _we already have_.
* * *
### **THIS WEEK ON AMPED UP:** Joyce Vance Sounds the Alarm on Trump's Federal Power Grab
In one of our most urgent and insightful episodes yet, _Amped Up_ welcomed former U.S. Attorney Joyce Vance to the program! We needed her brilliant legal mind to make sense of Donald Trump's explosive decision to federalize the National Guard in Los Angeles--a move Governor Gavin Newsom fought, and just won, in court.
Joyce unpacked for us the legal and constitutional chaos unfolding on the ground. And she explained in terms us non-lawyers can understand, why this moment represents a dangerous test of state authority, civil rights, and the limits of executive power.
As ICE raids escalate and federal agents increasingly obscure their identities, she laid how The Trump administration has pushed the boundaries of legality--and why this should concern _every_ American. Regardless of political party.
From Trump's abuse of the Insurrection Act to the legal implications of masked agents dragging people away without proper identification and face coverings like they're terrorists, this episode cuts through the noise and breaks it down in terms you won't hear anywhere else.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8da99927-2126-4c1e-8d51-1d723521ce0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We also touched on the alarming--and illegal--detention of Senator Alex Padilla, and the indictment of a sitting congresswoman. Both clear signs that our justice system is being twisted into a weapon against dissent by Trump's mini-me fascists in Congress.
Joyce brought to our show both a prosecutor's perspective and a constitutional scholar's insight--not to mention a great sense of humor!. She used all to explain why these moves threaten the very foundation of our democratic republic. How, as is so often said of Trump: This isn't normal, folks.
_But it 's not all doom and gloo_m -- **Cliff and David closed out the show by highlighting signs of resistance across the country, from brave protestors to judges and insiders who are still fighting --and risking much--for the rule of law**. If you're looking for clarity, urgency, and just a little hope in these chaotic times, this episode is a must-view.

#### _LA TIMELINE_
#### **June 7 -8, 2025 - Federalization Begins**
* **June 7** : President Trump, citing the Insurrection Act, federalized **2,000 California National Guard troops** , deploying **4,000 in total** along with **700 U.S. Marines** to Los Angeles amid protests against ICE raids
* California Governor Gavin Newsom **did not request** this federal intervention, sparking a legal and political backlash .

#### **June 9, 2025 - California Sues**
* California officially filed suit (Newsom v. Trump), challenging Trump's action under Tenth Amendment, Insurrection Act, and Posse Comitatus Act

#### **June 12, 2025 - District Court Blocks the Move**
* U.S. District Judge Charles Breyer issued a **36 ‐page temporary restraining order**, deeming the federalization **illegal** , citing violations of Trump's statutory authority and the Tenth Amendment
* The restraining order was set to take effect at **noon Pacific** on **June 13**

#### **June 12 evening - Trump Appeals**
* The federal government quickly appealed to the **9th U.S. Court of Appeals** , filing for an administrative stay of Judge Breyer's order

* The 9th Circuit **paused** Breyer's restraining order late **June 12** , allowing Trump's control over the California Guard to **remain in place** pending the appeal and scheduling a hearing on **June 17**

#### **June 13, 2025 - Status Update**
* As of today, federalized troops remain under Trump's command; the 9th Circuit's stay remains in effect, and a full oral argument is expected **June 17**

What Serbia Did, We Can Do: The Mass-Protest-vs-Trump Era Starts Now | | ---|---|--- Donald Trump is throwing himself a birthday parade in Washington, D.C. this Saturday. How cute. We all know how six-year olds like to be celebrated. But Trump's not just throwing any celebration, but a full-blown, authoritarian-style military display, more fitting for Pyongyang than Pennsylvania Avenue. It's not about patriotism. It's not about the troops. It's all about power. Control. Submission. And if we don't meet this particular moment with overwhelming resistance, Trump see this as he should--proof of our lack of stomach for the fight, and a permission slip to take us further into authoritarianism. So not only canwe meet the moment. We must. That's why Americans everywhere will rise tomorrow, June 14, under one rallying cry: . From coast to coast, peaceful mass protests are planned in hundreds of cities and localities. They're not partisan, they're about defending the Constitution from a carrot-tinted goon who'd sell it on eBay along with Tiffany. Or do to our Constitution what he's done--clearly without its consent--to the American flag. | | ---|---|--- Trump wants the optics of dominance, so we can 't let him have it. What we need is a tidal wave of democracy. Let's talk some numbers. One three months ago, over 325,000 Serbians took to the streets (some estimates had this number significantly larger, but we'll use the most cautious one). That was ~5% of their population publicly protesting the authoritarianism of Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić. A right-wing populist who's stripped his citizens of civil rights and attacked the press (sound familiar?). This was the largest protest in Serbian history. If the many Americans feeling hurt, angry, fearful, dismayed and economically wrecked turn out a similar percent of our populace to protest our own rubber-chicken fascist, 17MM Americans would hit the streets. So how about a reasonable and round number? Let 's get 15 MILLION Americans out tomorrow. FIFTEEN MILLION. That's you, me and Aunt Mildred. The mother-in-law you argue with about everything but Trump's cocoon of cretin. Your cousin who happens to be in town from Biloxi. Paul, your favorite brother. Fido, who needs a walk anyhow. All of us. In unison. Making it clear Trump 's dystopia is very much NOT our America. This would dwarf Trump's shriveling-mushroom parade in DC with his bone-spurred armored-vehicle brigade. It would show that we're not taking any more of the shit he's unleashed on Los Angeles, Congress and around the world. The moment for this ridiculous roid-rage-like rogue is as over as hair on Stephen Miller's dome. | | ---|---|--- Make no mistake, if we do this right, Trump becomes a lame duck before he even auto-pens the next executive order while losing/cheating at golf. Public pressure of this scale doesn't just shake headlines--it reshapes history. Congress feels it. The courts feel it. The military feels it. And most importantly, the American people see each other, standing shoulder to shoulder in a shared defense of our freedom. Hell, Mike Johnson might even stop monitoring his son's porn--just for a minute--to take stock of what he's up against. This is not a protest of despair, my friends. It's a protest of defiance. Of love for country. Of hope. And of belief in a republic, not a king. To repeat a famous anecdote, on the final day of the 1787 Constitutional Convention, when our Constitution was adopted, Americans gathered at Independence Hall in Philadelphia. They were waiting to discover what kind of government our Founding Fathers had created. | | ---|---|--- A prominent socialite and early staple of politics in Philly, Elizabeth Willing Powel, asked Benjamin Franklin, point blank, "What do we have, a republic or a monarchy?" To which Franklin replied, without missing a beat, "A republic, if you can keep it. Our responsibility is to keep it." That last line is often forgotten in the retelling,and it 's the most important one. It's our responsibility, as it was of those who preceded us, during civil and illegal wars, deportations, raids and voter suppression: To Keep Our Republic. We 're not powerless. We have the numbers. We have the moral high ground. And we have the right to assemble. If Trump wants tanks, armored trucks and goose-stepping CHUDS for a birthday present his dad forgot every year, then let him have it. We'll give him something much, much better: Millions of peaceful Americans waving pocket Constitutions, like lighters in a stadium during a rock ballad. And news coverage of it he can't avoid. So grab your signs. Print out your rights. Call your neighbors. or start one yourself. This isn't about waiting for anybody's permission. It's about using the power we already have. THIS WEEK ON AMPED UP: Joyce Vance Sounds the Alarm on Trump's Federal Power Grab In one of our most urgent and insightful episodes yet, Amped Up welcomed former U.S. Attorney Joyce Vance to the program! We needed her brilliant legal mind to make sense of Donald Trump's explosive decision to federalize the National Guard in Los Angeles--a move Governor Gavin Newsom fought, and just won, in court. Joyce unpacked for us the legal and constitutional chaos unfolding on the ground. And she explained in terms us non-lawyers can understand, why this moment represents a dangerous test of state authority, civil rights, and the limits of executive power. As ICE raids escalate and federal agents increasingly obscure their identities, she laid how The Trump administration has pushed the boundaries of legality--and why this should concern every American. Regardless of political party. From Trump's abuse of the Insurrection Act to the legal implications of masked agents dragging people away without proper identification and face coverings like they're terrorists, this episode cuts through the noise and breaks it down in terms you won't hear anywhere else. We also touched on the alarming--and illegal--detention of Senator Alex Padilla, and the indictment of a sitting congresswoman. Both clear signs that our justice system is being twisted into a weapon against dissent by Trump's mini-me fascists in Congress. Joyce brought to our show both a prosecutor's perspective and a constitutional scholar's insight--not to mention a great sense of humor!. She used all to explain why these moves threaten the very foundation of our democratic republic. How, as is so often said of Trump: This isn't normal, folks. Will rural clinics, food banks, and community centers have the resources they need to keep their doors open? Fellow Conservative,

You don’t call law enforcement Nazis unless you’ve decided you don’t believe in laws. That’s what Tim Walz did. He compared ICE agents—Americans who risk their lives enforcing the law—to the Gestapo.

_**Let that sink in.
**_
**These aren’t slip-ups. This is the modern Left’s playbook:**
* Undermine the rule of law.

* Demonize law enforcement.

* Accuse ordinary Americans of extremism for wanting basic security.

_**And then they call you a radical.**_

I’m Adam Schwarze. **I’m a former Navy SEAL and Marine who deployed nine times, including in Iraq and Africa, and I’m running for U.S. Senate to stop this madness. I didn’t spend 21 years defending this country just to come home and be called a Nazi by politicians who couldn’t even defend their own cities.**

While Minneapolis was burning in the summer of 2020,**Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, my opponent in the Minnesota Senate race** , was working on a lawsuit against the police. That tells you everything you need to know. **Democrats hide behind lawsuits and frivolous social media posts; Republicans rally behind the American flag and the men and women serving our communities in uniform.**

What they did to our cities was shameful. What they’re doing to our border is dangerous. And what they’re saying about veterans, police officers, and law-abiding citizens is disgusting.

So here’s the truth:
* Enforcing immigration law is not fascism. **It’s federal law.**

* Wanting to deport criminals who prey on Americans is not bigotry. **It’s basic decency.**

* Demanding accountability from a government that lets cities burn is not extreme. **It’s patriotism.**

I'm starting out this race with no money and little name recognition - what I do have is a deep love of this country, and an exemplarily military record. _**I would be humbled if you could spare a few dollars today to ensure my campaign for the U.S. Senate gets off the ground.**_

clean_body: Are you tired of watching cities fall apart, borders erased, and law enforcement demonized? | Fellow Conservative, You don’t call law enforcement Nazis unless you’ve decided you don’t believe in laws. That’s what Tim Walz did. He compared ICE agents—Americans who risk their lives enforcing the law—to the Gestapo. Let that sink in. These aren’t slip-ups. This is the modern Left’s playbook: Undermine the rule of law. Demonize law enforcement. Accuse ordinary Americans of extremism for wanting basic security. And then they call you a radical. I’m Adam Schwarze. I’m a former Navy SEAL and Marine who deployed nine times, including in Iraq and Africa, and I’m running for U.S. Senate to stop this madness. I didn’t spend 21 years defending this country just to come home and be called a Nazi by politicians who couldn’t even defend their own cities. While Minneapolis was burning in the summer of 2020,Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, my opponent in the Minnesota Senate race , was working on a lawsuit against the police. That tells you everything you need to know. Democrats hide behind lawsuits and frivolous social media posts; Republicans rally behind the American flag and the men and women serving our communities in uniform. What they did to our cities was shameful. What they’re doing to our border is dangerous. And what they’re saying about veterans, police officers, and law-abiding citizens is disgusting. So here’s the truth: Enforcing immigration law is not fascism. It’s federal law. Wanting to deport criminals who prey on Americans is not bigotry. It’s basic decency. Demanding accountability from a government that lets cities burn is not extreme. It’s patriotism. If you're as outraged as I am, I need your help now. I'm starting out this race with no money and little name recognition - what I do have is a deep love of this country, and an exemplarily military record. I would be humbled if you could spare a few dollars today to ensure my campaign for the U.S. Senate gets off the ground. This is the battle. Right here. Right now. Tim Walz and his radical, militant left-wing lieutenant governor think they can shame us into silence. They think they can call us names until we stop pushing back. They are wrong. I didn’t come from wealth. I wasn’t groomed for politics. I earned everything —from my SEAL trident to my Harvard and Johns Hopkins degrees—through service and sacrifice. And I’m bringing that same grit to this pivotal U.S. Senate race. But I need reinforcements. And that starts with you, Fellow Conservative. If you’re tired of watching cities fall apart, borders erased, and law enforcement demonized. And if you’re tired of being told that loving your country makes you a villain, Because we’re not the extremists. We’re the ones standing between America and collapse. With resolve, Adam Schwarze Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate - Minnesota FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate Adam Schwarze is a former Navy SEAL and Marine. body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
Tomorrow is the 250th anniversary of the United States Army, a day to celebrate and honor the extraordinary men and women who have served our country to secure, protect, and preserve our country and our freedom.
On June 14, 1775, following the fighting at Lexington and Concord against British troops, the Second Continental Congress voted to establish official companies to create the Continental Army, and the next day made George Washington its commander in chief.
It is incredible to think about all that has followed. All that we, the American people, have done, and tried to do, with the constitutional republic our founders created. All the work we have done to meet our highest aspiration and ideals and to make ours a more perfect union.
This week, we have seen that progress and the freedoms memorialized by our Declaration of Independence and protected by our Constitution under attack. President Trump and his deputies have threatened people and grabbed power across the country—from undermining and threatening the Governor of California and the Mayor of Los Angeles, to indicting a United States Congresswoman for conducting oversight, to flirting with a power grab to further erode democratic representation in Texas.
Given this backdrop, it is not surprising that President Trump has co-opted this weekend’s important anniversary to hold the dictator-style military parade in Washington, D.C. that he has requested for years, and the Pentagon has opposed, throwing himself a $45 million birthday party on our dime while telling those who plan to protest his administration that their exercise of their constitutional rights will be met with force and taking away benefits and services from our veterans.
That is unAmerican. The rights to assemble peacefully, to petition the government, and to speak freely are as old as our country and guaranteed in our Constitution.
And yet, that is what we are seeing every day. Including yesterday, when we saw federal agents detain and handcuff a sitting United States Senator asking a question at a press conference. If that happens to a U.S. Senator in front of cameras for all to see, what is happening when the cameras are not rolling? What is being done in our names in our own country?
It doesn’t have to be this way. With your support, we can hold the Trump administration accountable taking back the House majority in 2026. Make a contribution to help us fight back. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe250613?refcode=lpfe250613]
It’s not just the spectacle that’s troubling. It’s what it represents: the creeping normalization of authoritarianism, the bending of our institutions for personal power, and the steady erosion of the democratic values we hold most dear.
In times like these, we must think of what it truly means to serve—to put country over self, to protect democracy and reject autocracy, and to speak up when it would be easier to stay quiet.
We can’t look away at this moment. We must meet it. I’m asking you to stand with me. Will you join in today to help us meet this moment, defend our democracy, and win elections? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe250613?refcode=lpfe250613]
We cannot afford to look away, to disengage, or to let this become our new normal. This moment is frightening—but it’s not final. Together, we have the power—and the responsibility—to change things.
Together, we can do anything,

clean_body: ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [] Tomorrow is the 250th anniversary of the United States Army, a day to celebrate and honor the extraordinary men and women who have served our country to secure, protect, and preserve our country and our freedom. On June 14, 1775, following the fighting at Lexington and Concord against British troops, the Second Continental Congress voted to establish official companies to create the Continental Army, and the next day made George Washington its commander in chief. It is incredible to think about all that has followed. All that we, the American people, have done, and tried to do, with the constitutional republic our founders created. All the work we have done to meet our highest aspiration and ideals and to make ours a more perfect union. This week, we have seen that progress and the freedoms memorialized by our Declaration of Independence and protected by our Constitution under attack. President Trump and his deputies have threatened people and grabbed power across the country—from undermining and threatening the Governor of California and the Mayor of Los Angeles, to indicting a United States Congresswoman for conducting oversight, to flirting with a power grab to further erode democratic representation in Texas. Given this backdrop, it is not surprising that President Trump has co-opted this weekend’s important anniversary to hold the dictator-style military parade in Washington, D.C. that he has requested for years, and the Pentagon has opposed, throwing himself a $45 million birthday party on our dime while telling those who plan to protest his administration that their exercise of their constitutional rights will be met with force and taking away benefits and services from our veterans. That is unAmerican. The rights to assemble peacefully, to petition the government, and to speak freely are as old as our country and guaranteed in our Constitution. And yet, that is what we are seeing every day. Including yesterday, when we saw federal agents detain and handcuff a sitting United States Senator asking a question at a press conference. If that happens to a U.S. Senator in front of cameras for all to see, what is happening when the cameras are not rolling? What is being done in our names in our own country? It doesn’t have to be this way. With your support, we can hold the Trump administration accountable taking back the House majority in 2026. Make a contribution to help us fight back. [] It’s not just the spectacle that’s troubling. It’s what it represents: the creeping normalization of authoritarianism, the bending of our institutions for personal power, and the steady erosion of the democratic values we hold most dear. In times like these, we must think of what it truly means to serve—to put country over self, to protect democracy and reject autocracy, and to speak up when it would be easier to stay quiet. We can’t look away at this moment. We must meet it. I’m asking you to stand with me. Will you join in today to help us meet this moment, defend our democracy, and win elections? [] We cannot afford to look away, to disengage, or to let this become our new normal. This moment is frightening—but it’s not final. Together, we have the power—and the responsibility—to change things. subject: what happened to my colleague Senator Padilla yesterday
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY PEOPLE FOR PATTY MURRAY
body:
I cannot believe that we don’t have Senators on both sides of the aisle calling this out as outrageous.
| | |
---
Peter, in my more than 32 years serving Washington state in the U.S. Senate, I never thought something like this would happen.

The video of my colleague, U.S. Sen. Alex Padilla, being brutally tackled, thrown to the floor, and handcuffed at a Department of Homeland Security press conference in his own home state is a horrendous wake-up call to the urgent threats facing our democracy.
_Why? _**Because he dared to speak up to ****Trump’s Secretary of Homeland Security ****and demand answers for the millions of constituents he serves.**

In short, because he did his job.
We were chosen by the people of our states to speak up, to ask questions, and to be their voice in the halls of power. We use our voices and our votes to make change, not violence. That's what democracy is all about. So if that voice is stifled, so is the people's.
And now more than ever, American democracy is not guaranteed.
Every senator, regardless of party, must call out the administration on this. If we let this happen to any one of us, it can eventually happen to all of us.
And if this democracy is going to survive Trump's increasingly authoritarian tactics, then none of us can stay silent. **Don’t be intimidated. Speak up. Use your voice. Stand up for our democracy.**
It is the greatest honor of my life to be your voice in the other Washington. Thank you for your solidarity.

Patty

| | Let’s go back in time for a moment. After the 2018 elections, I founded Fair Fight — an organization dedicated to combating voter suppression and protecting voting rights. And Georgia’s 2021 runoff elections for the U.S. Senate showed [**exactly why this work is so critical.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109540404/551435872/1069921273?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250613_ff_SYATTV_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMDI0ZWFhNi05NTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5XKSMdgreYD_pDaB7LzDzuLzhgs24EZdGmTZ3q1fBtQ=) We saw an insidious attempt to intimidate voters — particularly Black, Brown, or first-time voters. **A Texas-based right-wing organization called True the Vote orchestrated the largest known mass voter eligibility challenge in Georgia’s history.** They provided volunteers with lists of voters from the United States Postal Service’s national change-of-address database — folks they flagged as ineligible to vote. Now, if you’ve ever moved, lived in college campus housing, or changed apartments, you know how the system works. Well, these anti-voter advocates used this database as evidence of ineligibility — even though the database can be outdated, and despite the fact that people who file to change their mailing address can still be properly registered to vote. Plus, the base of their challenges used unreliable postal data, as the United States Postal Service had already determined there was no guarantee on the quality of the data. True the Vote used this sleazy, shady practice to help facilitate more than 250,000 formal challenges. Voters received notifications questioning their right to vote simply because they used a convenience system designed to forward their mail. Imagine trying to cast a ballot and being singled out — pulled out of line — because your right to vote has been challenged. Or seeing your name posted publicly online with the accusation that you are ineligible to vote. And just in case the humiliation didn’t do the trick, True the Vote also discussed recruiting former Navy SEALs to monitor polling places. They even offered a $1 million bounty for reports of voter fraud. The sheer scale of these baseless challenges disrupted local election offices, burdened under-funded officials, created rampant confusion, and intimidated voters who had done nothing wrong. **Fair Fight has returned to federal court to take on True the Vote, oppose coordinated mass voter challenges, and end the ability of bad, cowardly actors to use this tactic to intimidate and overwhelm voters. ** **When necessary, Fair Fight takes its work to the courts. But they also work across communities and on campuses to slow or stop voter suppression efforts like mass challenges.** **And they invest in electing voting rights champions — such as Senators Raphael Warnock and Jon Ossoff in those 2021 elections — at the federal level as well as the state and local level, where key officials shape how elections are run.** [**The right to vote remains under constant attack, and the team at Fair Fight must be fully equipped to tackle new threats while pushing forward for free and fair elections. Will you make a donation of any amount to help fuel this work today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109540405/551435873/1069921273?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250613_ff_SYATTV_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMDI0ZWFhNi05NTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5XKSMdgreYD_pDaB7LzDzuLzhgs24EZdGmTZ3q1fBtQ=) Every eligible American should have the right to vote and have that vote counted. With that simple mission, Fair Fight has worked to stop the steady, methodical, cynical right-wing assaults on the bedrock of our shared values. And over the years, this work has only become more urgent. In March 2021, Georgia Governor Brian Kemp, a man with a reputation for being one of the nation’s most effective architects of voter suppression, opened the floodgates to even more mass voter challenges by signing SB 202 into law. That legislation allows unlimited voter challenges, which means that any person’s voter registration can be challenged as ineligible. Look: voter suppression isn’t new to America — or, sadly, to Georgia. And while both political parties have, at various times in history, treated those they considered undesirable voters as somehow criminal for exercising this fundamental constitutional right, in this century, **voter suppression is the strategy of choice for Republicans.** **True the Vote and GOP governors like Brian Kemp, Greg Abbott, and Ron DeSantis are the ideological descendants of those who have long opposed equal access to the ballot for all citizens, regardless of race or gender.** Across the country and now in the halls of Congress, Republicans are passing laws that make it harder for people to vote precisely because an engaged citizenry threatens their power. [**In the fight against tyranny and autocracy, we must defend the freedom to choose our leaders and vote our values. Fairness demands it. Make a donation now to fund and sustain that fight for our bedrock, pro-democracy ideals.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109540406/551435874/1069921273?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250613_ff_SYATTV_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMDI0ZWFhNi05NTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5XKSMdgreYD_pDaB7LzDzuLzhgs24EZdGmTZ3q1fBtQ=) Thank you, Stacey Abrams | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109540407/551435875/1069921273?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250613_ff_SYATTV_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMDI0ZWFhNi05NTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5XKSMdgreYD_pDaB7LzDzuLzhgs24EZdGmTZ3q1fBtQ=)

name: Wesley Bell
subject: We secured disaster relief for St. Louis—here’s what to know:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
Peter,

In the aftermath of the May 16 tornado that devastated our communities, I’ve been working closely with Mayor Spencer and elected officials at every level to get real help to St. Louis families—**and I’m proud to share that FEMA assistance is now available following a major disaster declaration.**

If you were impacted, here’s how to apply:

**Online:** DisasterAssistance.gov

**Call:** 800-621-FEMA (800-621-3362)

[**A full Disaster Assistance Center is open at Chaifetz Arena through June 26, offering housing support, legal aid, mental health services, and more. For those who need transportation, free Uber rides are available.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109540611/551436740/-671889611?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2EyMmM5NGQtOTc0OC1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VMpjyFNhPSbKkttqI8GEiRxpbdvqI1_h4psFPUU1bNk=&emci=718e0fe9-6548-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=7a22c94d-9748-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=1020964)

That’s real progress for St. Louis, but there’s still so much more work to do on the road to recovery — I know it won’t be easy, but we’re doing it together.

For updates, services, or ways to help, [**visit the St. Louis Recovery Page,**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109540612/551436741/323730846?cdmc=2yNWOtSsOyF1ot1fXR2RQJayOQb&refcode2=2yNWOtSsOyF1ot1fXR2RQJayOQb&refcodecdmc=2yNWOtSsOyF1ot1fXR2RQJayOQb&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2EyMmM5NGQtOTc0OC1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VMpjyFNhPSbKkttqI8GEiRxpbdvqI1_h4psFPUU1bNk=&emci=718e0fe9-6548-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=7a22c94d-9748-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=1020964) and remember, my office is always here for you if you need more support.

It was not meant to apply to foreign visitors... **And it was _definitely not_ for illegal aliens.** In fact, the text of the 14th Amendment clearly states that it only applies to “persons born or naturalized in the United States, **_AND_** subject to the jurisdiction thereof.” But over time, government bureaucrats stretched the 14th Amendment and automatically gave U.S. citizenship to every birth to illegal aliens, and even to foreign nationals vacationing in the United States. Now, the situation has gotten completely out of hand... **In 2023 alone, there were roughly 350,000 births to illegal aliens in the U.S. Tourists gave birth to another 40,000.** These so-called “anchor babies” can keep illegal alien parents from getting deported and give a legal basis for a whole chain of migrants to push their way into America. Is it any surprise that human traffickers and even high-end birth tourism companies are making billions of dollars? This is not by accident – it’s by design. In fact, the Obama State Department changed U.S. visa rules to explicitly allow women to travel to America for the purpose of giving birth in 2015! Thankfully, the Trump administration overturned this rule and pushed back on illegal immigration on a number of fronts. **_But Trump can’t do it alone._**

| Peter,

Last month, Republicans in the House passed a budget that cuts $715 billion in Medicaid funding over the next decade _and I proudly voted against it._

Here in my district, over 100,000 people rely on Medicaid for essential health care services. These cuts would leave many without access to the care they need, while also driving up costs for those with private insurance.

But it’s not just Long Islanders who will be affected. If these cuts go through, the entire country will feel the effects:
* Health care premiums will rise for everyone, as hospitals are forced to pass the costs onto consumers.

* Hospitals and clinics will be forced to cut services or even close, leaving rural and underserved areas without the care they need.

* State budgets will face massive shortfalls, leading to higher taxes and cuts to vital services like education and infrastructure.

We can’t let this happen. The stakes are too high for us here on Long Island and for every American across the country.

[_**I’m fighting against these cuts in Congress, but I need to know you have my back in this fight. That’s why I’m asking you to sign my petition today to show your support for Medicaid and send a message to Republicans that we won’t stand by and watch them dismantle this crucial program.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109541687/551440105/446597606?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzIwMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiY2E2ODI5NC05OTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YBgOmxJnuhDRwB0ijGP2uwH5Z2Q1DWzUcWrjOY9JsIY=&emci=f1fe878e-9948-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=bca68294-9948-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=7377580)

# _" Everyone move NOW!":_
# Fox News correspondent tells crew to TAKE COVER as Iranian missiles strike Tel Aviv
Fox News correspondent **[Trey Yingst was forced to take cover live on air](https://substack.com/redirect/4fa78865-9eb0-4d5c-8509-081f5698c28c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as Iran launched approximately 100 ballistic missiles at Tel Aviv, with 5-7 reportedly breaching Israel's missile defense systems. Yingst urgently directed his crew to move as explosions rocked the densely populated city, calling it "unprecedented" in his nearly seven years of reporting from Israel.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7aaa81fe-5b4d-45cc-a9bd-0bec6011ee59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **The attack directly targeted Tel Aviv** and other major Israeli population centers in retaliation for Israel's operation that killed top Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps officials. Yingst confirmed seeing ballistic missiles "slamming into the ground" with smoke rising from central Tel Aviv, noting that some missiles were not being intercepted despite Israel's Arrow Defense System and David's Sling being active.
* **Yingst described the moment** as "the big conflict that everyone discussed for decades... Israel versus Iran," emphasizing this was a direct attack on Israel's second-largest city. Israeli officials had warned of the incoming attack and cut short briefings as the missiles launched, with Yingst and his crew safely evacuating the area during the live broadcast.

# Florida sheriff WARNS anti-ICE protesters: 'we will kill you' for attacking police
A Florida County Sheriff has issued a stern warning to protesters planning violent demonstrations, stating that **[any acts of aggression toward law enforcement will result in deadly force.](https://substack.com/redirect/b1236b18-3455-4660-8549-0f621a09c141?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/1f4975ce-e8dd-42a1-98e7-e3d0331b4bf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Brevard County Sheriff Wayne Ivey** declared on Thursday that "If you throw a brick, a firebomb, or point a gun at one of our deputies, we will be notifying your family where to collect your remains because we will kill you, graveyard dead. We're not going to play."
* **Violence Will Not Be Tolerated:** He further warned that blocking vehicles or engaging in mob behavior could result in being run over and dragged across the street, and that physical assaults on officers, such as spitting or striking, would lead to hospitalization, arrest, and potential interaction with K-9 units.
* **His comments coincide with the recent anti-ICE protests** taking place nationwide, and the "No Kings" protests taking place this Saturday organized by the 50501 Movement, set to coincide with President Trump's parade for the 250th birthday of the US Army.

# Manhunt underway for four migrant escapees from Newark ICE facility
Four migrant detainees escaped from a federal immigration detention facility in Newark, New Jersey following a disturbance, Thursday, prompting a manhunt and raising concerns about security conditions, **[a Department of Homeland Security official confirmed.](https://substack.com/redirect/14c5c443-f16b-48fe-81c3-d9eaca2784bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Cause of Disturbance** : Approximately 50 detainees reportedly became agitated due to delayed meals, pushing down a weak dormitory wall.
* **Facility Details** : The facility, operated by the GEO Group under a $900 million contract with the Trump administration, has faced criticism for overcrowding and inadequate conditions. "We demand immediate answers and clear communication with the GEO Group and the Department of Homeland Security." Newark Mayor Ras J. Baraka said. "We must put an end to this chaos and not allow this operation to continue unchecked."
* **Response** : Law enforcement agencies have initiated a manhunt for the escapees last seen running near Turnpike 78 and Delancey Street, and additional security measures have been implemented at the facility.

What happened yesterday should shake every one of us.
First, Donald Trump sent Marines into the streets of Los Angeles to confront protesters, purposefully inflaming division and fear.
Then, Senator Alex Padilla of California was handcuffed and thrown to the ground for daring to speak up and hold this administration accountable.

This isn’t tough politics. This is a warning sign for our democracy.

This is why I’m in this fight. To protect our democracy. And we’re going to fight like hell to keep it.
I'm not taking my foot off the gas,
Maxine

This has been a very trying week for my home state of California. Between the heartwrenching stories of families being ripped apart to Trump sending the military into Los Angeles to DHS’ mistreatment of Senator Alex Padilla, it really feels like our state, and our communities, are under attack. I want to be very clear: we have laws and a Constitution here in our country and our President has a duty to follow them. As citizens, we also have a duty to make our voices heard. That’s why I have publicly demanded that the Trump Administration immediately deescalate the situation and follow the law. All of this is leading up to tomorrow, where Trump is throwing himself a military parade in D.C. for his birthday. Tanks. Artillery launchers. Thousands of U.S. troops. It’s a taxpayer-funded spectacle designed to stroke Trump’s ego and turn our brave servicemembers into political props. It will end a week marked by scenes we never thought we'd witness in this country. I know people are feeling scared and overwhelmed. Know that I stand with you and many of my colleagues do as well. We can, and must, make our voices heard. [_**If you want to help give Trump the birthday present he deserves, please donate to our campaign so we can win back the House and show Trump we’re fighting back.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109542387/551442688/1119658952?&refcode=E13728-20250613-TrumpCalifornia-SL-CampaignNews&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTE4YzkwOTctOWI0OC1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=z_E864gxYjlMmc5fmnNDvGy7kZRQ0f8ONTu9D5eemu0=) \- Josh

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Handcuffing a United States Senator
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Alex was trying to ask Secretary Noem a question, in his own state, to keep his constituents safe. It is his job, as a United States senator.
#

Team, it takes a lot to shock me.
Yesterday was shocking. Senator Alex Padilla was shoved, pinned, and handcuffed by federal agents at a press conference held by Secretary of Homeland Security Kristi Noem. It’s behavior I have never seen before.
Alex was trying to ask Secretary Noem a question, in his own state, to keep his constituents safe. It is his job, as a United States senator and a member of the Senate Judiciary Committee, to provide oversight in situations like this. He’s a good man, a good senator, a good advocate for the people of his state — and he had every right to be there.
Still, he was violently forced to the ground and handcuffed.
While I am shocked, I am not surprised. This is part of a pattern of inflammatory behavior from Donald Trump’s White House, and it is leading our country down a dangerous path.
I’ll echo Senator Padilla now and say this: If that’s how they treat a United States senator, imagine how they’re treating everyday people, when the cameras aren’t rolling.
I assure you, I will continue taking action to hold this Administration accountable.
You have my word on that.
Thank you,
Mark

Peter,
While Trump was deploying the National Guard and Marines against peaceful protesters in Los Angeles, Marie Gluesenkamp Perez was passing around an op-ed she co-authored with her centrist "friends" in the Blue Dog Coalition to praise Speaker Mike Johnson and offer him a "bipartisan way forward." I'm not kidding.
---
| [ ](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv6r8GR7zKbLdKY8JcRsBH8aQhQzL-6XFLiJ1IzrYZqHcVu3_2xEWSSvdjjDmkiSUBAfturCC4PzdjZegoW_jHGI0ODShTIC4tGBLFGZSnVxnWOsY3UUY8uJH07IlkGqhyHPWs_WFH9fGl_pDz62TrQnC_mSI0U2QhpLHfeMPopBHGdJ2HriebXUOIsT-g5l9sjEJkG9ZRFDu25MFaCsViSMcIQxlyS91I3OkoyevRAeN4pRWiQs9enPugOUKFZnYW9_4VKK5rJw8x6Zy1AoG8sR4BQ4iwZtkoTtHKyYgWlSv7J6qsfZ1PG9-K-9zxSMj_s1Hs9a1zahuEUpwLRweVbFk4z5lg45401g7pqJC1sWTdm5MaTtFt8_83giOS15Ps/4hb/oNYC6bYNSN-z5sN4WEuZ4A/h1/h001.pFnCW12JyGi2psetLgMv3W1W-a5yLJxqDb45G_QfxOs)
---
This stunt follows Marie headlining _WelcomeFest, a D.C_. billionaire-backed event where the big ideas included: deregulating Big Tech, break up unions, and purge LGBTQ folks and working-class organizers from the Democratic Party. Marie says she's for the trades, but I've never seen a union sheet metal worker invited to a conference like that. She talks like a Democrat back home. But in D.C.? **She writes love letters to the far right while the Marines roll down Sunset Boulevard.** And for what? Some tired centrist experiment that's failed for decades. "Blue Dog Democrat" is so 20 years ago. They've already tried at least three other names: Third Way, Problem Solvers, New Dems. None of them ever built a real coalition or delivered for working people. All they've done is stall bold Democratic progress every time we had a shot. name: With Honor Action
subject: Bats, Brews, and a Birthday Salute to the U.S. Army
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WITH HONOR ACTION, INC
body:
| | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a6ad7422f8b9/bats-brews-and-a-birthday-salute-to-the-us-army?e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| | | |
---
| | | |
### Friends,
---
| In a town known more for filibusters than fastballs, once a year, Congress trades suits for cleats in the century-old [Congressional Baseball Game](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=0c9683634a&e=33f53a5b1a)—a bipartisan tradition where Democrats and Republicans face off in a contest that’s equal parts rivalry, comedy, and surprisingly decent baseball—as seen [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=ae654d3c0d&e=33f53a5b1a) with For Country Caucus member Rep. August Pfluger flashing the leather with an incredible play at third base. From dugout jokes to post-game ice packs, these players bring humor, humility, and hope to the national pastime—showing that even in one of the most polarized political climates in modern memory, there’s still room for sportsmanship, teamwork, and the occasional dropped fly ball. For the [For Country Caucus](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=603e8c5713&e=33f53a5b1a), it’s a chance to live out their [pledge](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=04f780253a&e=33f53a5b1a) to serve with integrity, civility, and the courage to cross the aisle. It is a fitting backdrop for a national pastime that reminds us what public service can be. Even after leaving office, you're never far from the field. Just ask former Rep. Brad Wenstrup, back to greet his old friend and fellow Caucus member, Rep. Jimmy Panetta. Because, in the end, it’s more than just a game—it’s a reminder of what still brings us together.
---
|
---
| | _From Center: For Country Caucus Rep. Jimmy Panetta and former For Country Caucus member and Representative, Brad Wenstrup_
---
|
---
| In a city that runs on caffeine and conversation, Wednesday’s coffee giveaway was a rare blend of both. With Yellowstone’s Cole Hauser serving up more than just screen presence—and Free Rein Coffee pouring into mugs and missions—we teamed up with Walmart to host a moment of pause and purpose at the new veteran-owned [Frontier House](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=3b586d9c07&e=33f53a5b1a) on Capitol Hill. Between light remarks and strong brews, staffers gathered not just for free coffee but for a shared cause: supporting those who have served, one cup at a time.
---
|
---
_Cole Hauser, star actor in Yellowstone and co-founder of Free Rein Coffee_
|
---
_From Left: Arlyn Davich, Melody Richard, Cole Hauser, Sean Corrigan, and Rye Barcott_
|
---
| In a nation shaped by service, few institutions have stood taller—or longer—than the United States Army. For 250 years, the Army has answered the call, from muddy battlefields to modern frontlines, forging a legacy not just of strength but of sacrifice, discipline, and duty. Tomorrow, as we mark a quarter millennium of service, we don’t just celebrate a military branch—we honor a fighting force that has helped define the American story. Here’s to the soldiers past and present who’ve stood watch so the rest of us could sleep soundly. Happy birthday, U.S. Army.
---
|
---
| Rye Barcott
CEO & Co-Founder
With Honor Action

Friends, I’m sure you’ve seen the footage of Senator Alex Padilla being forcefully removed, pushed to the ground, and handcuffed while attempting to ask a question at a DHS press conference.
It’s despicable, and it’s scary.
Not only does the Constitution literally mandate that as a Member of Congress he ask questions and conduct oversight where it’s needed – it’s also his constitutional right as an American.
Watching a United States senator be tackled to the ground simply for asking why the military has been deployed into his hometown (over the objections of its mayor and governor!) should raise every single alarm bell we’ve got.
So what can we do? Here are three things I think we should all do right now:
1. Support Senator Padilla. Click here to make a split donation and let him know you’re behind him. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em-padilla]
2. Do NOT stop peacefully protesting and raising your voice. I’ll be at the No Kings Day of Action at Waterfront Park [https://www.mobilize.us/indivisible/event/788443/] on Saturday, and I hope to see you there. (Or find another event near you [https://www.nokings.org/#map] – there are protests and rallies in more than 1,500 cities!)
3. Call your representatives at (202) 224-3121 and urge them to demand answers from Senate Majority Leader Thune and Secretary Noem about this unacceptable incident.
I’ll leave you with one really important learning from my time working in post-coup transitions and conflict stabilization before I came to Congress:
When we see democratic backsliding – and that’s exactly what we’re seeing – the most important thing we can do is stay in community. Trump is counting on us to be too intimidated or overwhelmed or tired to push back. So we have to do the opposite.
Participating in these peaceful protests, connecting with groups, and staying in close touch with others who care about this country does so much to protect democracy – so please keep going.
Thanks for reading. I hope to see you tomorrow!
-Sara

subject: The law is on our side
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROB BONTA FOR CALIFORNIA ATTORNEY GENERAL 2026 FPPC ID #145642
body:
We feel confident in our case and that the law is on our side.
# [](https://act.robbonta.com/go/3?refcode=em20250613&t=1&akid=1826%2E1088799%2EX8At2J)
After I filed a lawsuit to stop President Trump and Defense Secretary Hegseth from unlawfully federalizing the California National Guard, a court issued a temporary restraining order blocking them from deploying the Guard to Los Angeles and directing them to return control to the Governor. A few hours later, the Ninth Circuit granted an administrative stay, allowing the National Guard to stay deployed over the weekend. While the decision is disappointing, it’s far from the end of the road.
Things have been moving quickly, so I wanted you to hear directly from me: **We feel confident in our case and that the law is on our side. We will continue making our case in court, and we hope to prevail.**
**[If you’re with me, pitch in $5 to fuel my campaign as I hold Trump accountable to the law.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250613?refcode=em20250613-1826&amount=5&refcode2=1826_1088799_X8At2J&akid=1826%2E1088799%2EX8At2J)**
Let’s be clear: **The President’s orders are illegal and dangerous. He’s looking for any excuse to use the military to silence those who speak out against him.** Trump’s order is cowardly and a violation of our fundamentally American right to peacefully protest.
As Chief Law Enforcement Officer in California, **I will always enforce our Constitution and your First Amendment right** to speak truth to power and gather, peacefully and lawfully, to demand change. That’s why we are going back to court to keep arguing our case.
As ICE agents raid our communities – taking parents, workers, and loved ones away from their lives – Californians in LA and across the state are standing up for their rights and freedoms, peacefully and lawfully. Our rights must be respected, and I will keep fighting in court to ensure they are.
**[As long as this president and his administration continue breaking the law, we’ll keep taking them to court. If you’re with me, make a contribution of any amount today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250613?refcode=em20250613-1826&amount=5&refcode2=1826_1088799_X8At2J&akid=1826%2E1088799%2EX8At2J)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250613?refcode=em20250613-1826&amount=5&refcode2=1826_1088799_X8At2J&akid=1826%2E1088799%2EX8At2J)**
In solidarity,
Rob

This week, history moved.
Israel launched airstrikes on Tehran, targeting military and nuclear facilities and killing four commanders. In response, Iranian missiles were fired--and the United States intervened to block those missiles in midair.
"It's a Matter of Integrity" by Melissa Chaudhry is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tZWxpc3NhNGNvbmdyZXNzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.8LMacxcsI8espzhxsE2z6aHdmctw_yyEeHrWkJi3ZTU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=165902534)
And barely a month ago, a skirmish between India and Pakistan flared into the most strategically significant military exchange of the year. Pakistan shot down Indian fighter jets that were flying NATO-standard French and American aircraft, using two-generations-old Chinese defense technology. The implications are profound.
The headlines will frame these events as isolated flareups. They are not.
**They are markers in a shifting global reality that American leadership is largely refusing to acknowledge.**
For much of the past century, U.S. global power has rested on a threefold pillar: **financial dominance** (via the dollar), **technological leadership** , and **military superiority**. Of these, military superiority has been the linchpin -- the silent assumption underpinning the petrodollar, global trade patterns, and U.S. political leverage across continents.
But that pillar is cracking.
When last-generation Chinese air defense systems can shoot down the latest NATO jets, we are witnessing a technological leveling of the playing field. **The U.S. no longer holds an unchallenged edge in military hardware or electronic warfare**. Other nations have caught up -- some have quietly surpassed.
In Washington, this is not being spoken of. From Congressmembers, and on the media, I hear almost no reckoning with this new reality. Instead, we are **doubling down on military spending,** as though _more dollars poured into outdated assumptions will rebuild an eroding foundation._
Here is the truth:
**The harder we lean on military force as our primary tool of global influence, the more brittle and exposed we become.**
The future will not be secured through more weapons contracts, more bases, or more interventions. The future will be secured through _principled leadership, economic reinvestment, regenerative alliances, and moral legitimacy_ -- none of which can be purchased through superior firepower.
What we saw this week should be a wake-up call.
Instead, many in Washington are hitting the snooze button -- if they are even listening at all.
We can and must choose another path. Not a path of retreat, but a path of wiser engagement:
* Investing in domestic resilience, not endless wars.
* Building peace through diplomacy, not dominance.
* Earning respect through justice, not fear.

The world is changing. Our leadership must change with it -- or history will move past us.
I will not stop speaking this truth.
For peace. For justice. For a better future for all.

Every voter needs to become educated voters, who are not tied to one party and who vote for candidates that share their views regardless of their political party affiliation.

**➤➤ BREAKING: Trump’s AI plan could wipe out state protections for a decade** [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109545346/551450343/1641447874?refcode=em-6.13.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YmY3ODhjMi1hMTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=M8xd7GQaaVhrHslnK4Yl9LCwLBJD11l9cH0O-VnAkZI=)
* * *
Senate Republicans have quietly kept a 10-year moratorium on state AI laws in their latest version of Donald Trump’s massive federal budget package, which is heading to the Senate for a vote. Let us be blunt: this hands Big Tech a decade-long free pass, and rips away the ability of states to protect consumers, workers, and democracy from the harms of unregulated artificial intelligence. The House already passed it as part of the so-called “One Big Beautiful Bill Act” (some without even reading it). Now it’s up to the Senate — and **if it passes there, state leaders will be banned from enacting or enforcing AI rules until 2035.** What does that mean?
* ➤ No regulation of algorithmic bias.
* ➤ No limits on AI-powered surveillance.
* ➤ No protections against deep fakes or misinformation tools that could destabilize elections.
* ➤ No federal standards.
* ➤ No corporate accountability.
* ➤ No timeline for real regulation.

Now, every state in the country will be prevented from having basic regulations to protect workers and to protect consumers. Horrifying. At DASS, we’re sounding the alarm too — and we’re standing with the Secretaries of State who have long been leaders in protecting democratic institutions from unchecked power, including corporate overreach. clean_body: I’m running for the Senate against a politician who, while our streets burned, pushed lawsuits against law enforcement officials | Fellow Conservative, My name is Adam Schwarze, and I’m a former Navy SEAL, Marine Corps veteran, and proud Minnesotan running for U.S. Senate against Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor—a politician even more radical than her boss. I’m requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota. I hold a Master’s from Harvard, a Master’s Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations. I’m starting this race with absolutely nothing , but because of the enormity of the race's outcome, I figured there is no harm in asking for your help. At the end of the day, my request of you will end in one of two ways: 1.) . 2.) you read this email without contributing, but you at least now know who I am. I’m not a career politician. I’m a regular guy from a working-class family who grew up playing hockey and answered our nation’s call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks. I joined the Marine Corps to defend our country, and as a Navy SEAL, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to protect our freedoms and way of life. Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the National Guard before his unit deployed to Iraq, I never backed down from serving our nation during war. Minnesota is at a crossroads. Under Governor Walz and his lieutenant governor, our state has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent unrest in Minneapolis in 2020, defunded our police , and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and inflation. While our streets burned, the lieutenant governor pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the officers keeping us safe. This isn’t the Minnesota I grew up in—or the one any Minnesotan deserves. If you are reading this email right now and you don’t live in Minnesota, then I’m sure you’ll agree with me that every American must be represented by individuals in Congress who want to build a better version of the America we live in today—individuals of integrity. That’s not who my opponent is. We have an incredible opportunity to elect a Republican to the U.S. Senate next year - something voters in this state haven’t done since they re-elected former Senator Norm Coleman in 2002. As a Republican, I know the odds are tough in a state that hasn’t voted red in a presidential election since 1976. But as a former Navy SEAL, I thrive in tough fights. I’ve faced worse odds overseas and am ready to bring that same grit to Washington. Here’s what I stand for: Restoring law and order by supporting our police and cracking down on crime. Cutting taxes and regulations to ease the burden on retirees and small businesses. Securing our borders to protect our communities and sovereignty. Defending our Second Amendment rights and traditional values. Stopping the radical left’s agenda that’s eroding the America we love. You don’t know me, but you know what men like me stand for and our reputation. So, . This race won’t be easy. The Democrats have deep pockets, and the radical left will stop at nothing to keep this seat. I’m running to serve you, to protect our way of life, and to ensure Minnesota remains a place where faith, family, and freedom thrive. I hope you’ll invest in me right now – any amount will help. U.S. Senator Katie Britt participated in a Senate Appropriations Committee hearing this week focused on the President’s Fiscal Year 2026 (FY26) Budget Proposal for the Department of Commerce. The hearing featured Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and addressed national priorities such as economic development, job creation, and industrial competitiveness.

During the hearing, Senator Britt spotlighted Alabama’s advancements in biotechnology, particularly through the work of Southern Research and the Birmingham Biotech Hub.
