body:
Social Security reform is a frequent topic in Washington - how should it be done if it is?

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=friday_social_security_follow&n=1)
---
| Peter -- It's time for the newest installment of _**Control What You Can.**_ Last week, as a part in our series on tackling the national debt, we asked about where the government could focus to get expenditures under control. It's no surprise that reforming programs such as Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security was a key area of focus. This week, we're going to focus on Social Security. Reforming that system has long been seen as the "third rail" of politics. The program is so popular, and people (rightfully) feel ownership of the system since they pay into it. Its relationship to the budget, deficit, and debt is complex because of how it's structured, but one thing is sure - on its current trajectory, it's projected to run a shortfall, requiring the government to either cut benefits, find money to fund benefits elsewhere, or reform the system. We're going to ask about the last option \- if you were in charge, which of the following reforms would you consider first in reforming Social Security? body:
The Nebraska I love deserves leadership grounded in compassion, courage, and community.

| | | | | [|

| | | | | Dear friend,
I’ve been asked:_Do I miss it?_
The long nights on the floor. The tough, honest conversations. The responsibility of serving all the people of Nebraska.
The answer is yes! But what I’ve missed most is the opportunity to make a real difference—to do the kind of work that changes lives for the better.
I’ve missed using my voice to bring people together, not watching them be driven apart. I’ve missed standing up for kids, for families, for workers, and for our bright future.
[**So today, I’m proud to share that I’m running to return to the Nebraska Legislature.**](https://pattyfornebraska.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1fe11ab9469ef0db7208a1c3b&id=ba37585e74&e=7a0216d1ea)
After serving in the Unicameral and campaigning in 2022, I never stopped paying attention. I never stopped caring. And I never stopped believing that politics can be a force for good—if we lead with heart and stay grounded in what really matters.
Now more than ever, Nebraska needs steady hands and open hearts. We need leaders who still believe public service is about everyone, not just the powerful few. That’s who I’ve always been.
If you believe Nebraska deserves better, I’m asking you to join me. [**Will you be one of the first grassroots supporters of this campaign?**](https://pattyfornebraska.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1fe11ab9469ef0db7208a1c3b&id=a6fc9268a7&e=7a0216d1ea)

clean_body: The Nebraska I love deserves leadership grounded in compassion, courage, and community. | | | | | | | | | | Dear friend, I’ve been asked:Do I miss it? The long nights on the floor. The tough, honest conversations. The responsibility of serving all the people of Nebraska. The answer is yes! But what I’ve missed most is the opportunity to make a real difference—to do the kind of work that changes lives for the better. I’ve missed using my voice to bring people together, not watching them be driven apart. I’ve missed standing up for kids, for families, for workers, and for our bright future. After serving in the Unicameral and campaigning in 2022, I never stopped paying attention. I never stopped caring. And I never stopped believing that politics can be a force for good—if we lead with heart and stay grounded in what really matters. Now more than ever, Nebraska needs steady hands and open hearts. We need leaders who still believe public service is about everyone, not just the powerful few. That’s who I’ve always been. If you believe Nebraska deserves better, I’m asking you to join me. | | | | | Whether or not you’re able to give, I hope you’ll follow along, share your ideas, and help shape this campaign in the months ahead. Let’s move Nebraska forward—together. With gratitude, Patty Pansing Brooks | | | | | | | Paid for by Pansing Brooks for Legislature | | | | | | | | or |

body:
---
| | Peter,

As you may have heard, ICE recently raided a local institution, Buona Forchetta restaurant here in South Park. They sent in 20 federal agents with machine guns and flash-bang grenades, dispersing civilians dining on an otherwise peaceful night, and ultimately arresting four employees.

You would have thought they were going after a drug kingpin or dangerous criminal – the campaign platform on which Trump ran – but instead, their targets at Buona Forchetta and in raids across the country are hardworking people who contribute to our economy.

My question is this: How does scaring restaurant patrons and arresting dishwashers and line cooks make us safer? The answer is: it doesn’t.

Trump and MAGA Republicans in Congress use “waste, fraud, and abuse” to justify slashing billions of dollars in funding for Medicaid and SNAP, firing VA employees, and gutting federal services that keep us safe and healthy.

But – the real waste is federalizing California’s national guard for Trump’s manufactured crisis, and sending 20 law enforcement agents in full military tactical gear to detain 4 people and intentionally intimidate a restaurant full of employees and civilians.

It’s time to take a stand to protect our neighbors and defend their humanity.

I joined my colleagues to demand answers and accountability for ICE’s aggression in the South Park raid, and the concerns it raises about the Trump Administration’s use of intimidation tactics to sow fear instead of upholding the law. [**Add your name here to amplify our call to action.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109547931/551459184/-643903877?refcode2=737911fe-aa48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&refcode=SP_EM_EN_90DO_250613_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzkvMS84ODA2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Mzc5MTFmZS1hYTQ4LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=i_YrHXekBSc7zu9q86TDPqpQfGrVknjrJfkpP4JhKMM=&emci=707911fe-aa48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=737911fe-aa48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=5258741)

Rest assured that I will continue to put pressure on the Administration, the Department of Homeland Security, and ICE as long as they continue to inflict violence and sow chaos in our communities – because if we don’t hold them accountable now, they won’t stop with just San Diego.

They sent in 20 federal agents with machine guns and flash-bang grenades, dispersing civilians dining on an otherwise peaceful night, and ultimately arresting four employees. You would have thought they were going after a drug kingpin or dangerous criminal – the campaign platform on which Trump ran – but instead, their targets at Buona Forchetta and in raids across the country are hardworking people who contribute to our economy. #
Friend, When I talk about fighting for the Central Valley, I’m talking about _everyone_. **Illnesses like Valley Fever don’t care about whether you’re Democrat, Republican, or didn’t vote last election – and neither do I. They affect all of us.** Valley Fever cases are skyrocketing here in California. It’s caused by breathing in dust, which, if you haven't driven down the 5 lately, is plentiful here in the Central Valley. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109548044/551459762/-1711067489?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2FhY2NlM2MtYWM0OC1mMDExLThmN2MtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=6-f2vCpawhzpNgyr6Di5Rs5HqY5vRASLnqAgObHLVS4=&emci=9a530717-a647-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=7aacce3c-ac48-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=1120212) Most people clear an infection without even noticing it. But for others, it leads to serious complications. When the spores move from the lungs to the brain, it can cause a dangerous form of meningitis. **Right now, it’s hitting our communities hard.** Too many people get sick and don’t even know what’s wrong for weeks. Peaceful protest is enshrined in the Bill of Rights. It is a right Americans have exercised throughout our nation's history to protest injustice, tyranny, and government overreach. The Trump regime is once again ~~testing~~ trampling upon this right. Trump is clear he does not respect the right to peaceful protest, so we must be ready. As you protest on June 14 (and I hope you do--[find your local protest here](https://substack.com/redirect/8ed837d6-4fc9-4cb9-8205-624eb3917ec8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)), here are some key tips to remember to protect yourself and your loved ones.
**Let 's Address This.**
**Quick Ask! I am doing everything in my power to stave off fascism in the United States, and I need your support. Subscribe and join more than 132,000 fellow activists.**

---|---|---
## Why We Must Be Ready While Protesting
First, a quick overview of the gravity of the current situation.
A Latino Senator, Alex Padilla, dared to ask DHS Secretary Noem a question. He was violently tackled and arrested and now the Speaker wants him censured.
A Jewish Congressman, Jerry Nadler, challenged Trump. His staffer was handcuffed in an illegal raid by Trump's goons.
A Black congresswoman, LaMonica McIver, allegedly grazed the arm of an ICE agent while doing her job. She was arrested and is now being criminally prosecuted.
Meanwhile, Trump pardoned the white supremacists and Nazis who violently stormed the Capitol, smeared feces on the walls, called to hang Mike Pence and kill Nancy Pelosi, and beat police officers to death.
These are not coincidences. This is violent intimidation.
Trump's autocratic regime is aggressively attacking and intimidating minority elected officials, just like his goons are raiding minority immigrants. He wants every Black, Latino, and Jewish person to know that if any minority dares to speak up, we will face that same violence and arrest. It's why Trump continues to raid Black and brown communities, but ignores the 600K+ undocumented white immigrants in the United States. It's why Trump blocks vetted Afghan refugees facing actual harm from the Taliban, but welcomes random white Afrikaaners on a made up claim of harm.
It was never about immigration. It was never about rule of law. It was always about advancing white supremacy. "MAGA" always meant a return Jim Crow America, and this week proved it once again. We need unity against this fascism, as that is the only way any of us survive this.
Therefore, as you loudly and proudly protest this week, or any week, remember these tips to keep yourself safe and protected, especially if things go south.
## 13 Rules to Protect Yourself While Protesting
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/65e81200-5d4b-4d33-b60e-2e4f6296d4b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
1. If you are undocumented or your immigration status is in processing, it is highly advisable you avoid these protests altogether.
2. Ensure your loved ones know where you are and what time you will meet them at a pre-determined location. Do not leave your location to chance--ensure your loved ones are in the know.
3. Have the phone number's of your lawyer and loved ones memorized in case you need to call them from memory.
4. If stopped by law enforcement for any reason, ask simply if you are free to go. If they answer yes, then walk away and do not double back.
5. If the answer is no, do not voluntarily talk to police, the military, ICE, or any member of law enforcement, and do not volunteer any information about yourself. Do not initiate conversation. You always have the right to remain silent.
6. Remember that law enforcement can lie to you to get what they want. You cannot lie to law enforcement. Under no circumstance should you lie to law enforcement. The best way to not lie, is to not speak. Simply remain silent.
**If you 're finding value in this guidance, support our efforts as a free or paid subscriber.**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..CB3vajKIGchGy2AdCl6lH8sXVVC-iTrNiGPbmROvICM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=165905383)
7. If you are in fact detained or arrested, do not sign anything, do not admit to anything, and do not confess anything. Simply ask to speak to your lawyer. Repeatedly ask in the clearest terms possible that you would like to speak with your lawyer. Period.
8. You can lawfully ask any law enforcement officer or military person to share their name and badge number with you, and what department they represent. You should do this if your rights are violated. But do not volunteer any information about yourself. Some states require you to disclose your name. [Here is a helpful resource to determine if your state is one such state](https://substack.com/redirect/fe300ac7-fd74-47ab-b54f-839eeed0fab5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
9. You can lawfully record in any public space, anything that is in plain view.
10. You can march in the streets or on any public space and the police cannot arrest or detain you. However, if you are deliberately obstructing public throughways, you can be detained.
11. Be aware of states like [Florida](https://substack.com/redirect/a03eb821-efe5-4b51-b0f2-e723fdd237da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) where the MAGA Governor is a known extremist who supports drivers for running over protestors if "they feel threatened." (That "feeling" definition remains subjective). [Here is a brief overview of the states that allow drivers to effectively run over protestors](https://substack.com/redirect/30a7db9b-e875-4552-ba61-69b9267bbd94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Observe your safety in these and other red states.
12. Generally speaking, law enforcement can ask you to unlock your phone by Face ID or finger print, but _not_ by entering your passcode. Set your phone security to require your passcode to unlock it. Do Not Voluntarily Unlock Your Phone For Law Enforcement For Any Reason.
13. Be fearless and speak truth even if your voice shakes. Know that you are standing on the right side of history, of protecting our Republic from fascists. Godspeed my friends.

## Conclusion
The stakes have never been higher, and silence has never been more dangerous. And that's exactly why I have the deepest gratitude to the millions of you who will be proudly and loudly protesting for justice and human rights. As a human rights lawyer, nothing makes me more proud than seeing my fellow countrymen and women rise up in unison against oppression. Finally, if you believe in truth, justice, and protecting the vulnerable--then I hope to earn your trust and support as well. Support my human rights advocacy by [becoming a subscriber](https://substack.com/redirect/45ab36a2-37f5-4928-9300-ae16cf1fa9f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), sharing this advocacy widely, and helping us stay loud, relentless, and rooted in principle.
Because the fight for our rights demands all of us. Let's get to work. ❤️✊🏽

Fellow American,

Most Americans can agree - The ideological abuse our children have suffered in recent years is unlike anything we have seen in our lifetimes.

Despite recent progress, our public education system is STILL trying to push this ideological warfare in our kids' faces without parents' permission.

LGBT extremism and transgenderism have no place in our society, especially our classrooms. I call these extremist groups the **" alphabet mafia"**.

| [ **STOP THE ALPHABET MAFIA** ](http://links.bbapac.com/u/click?_t=5784e5e40dc94351a7bcbabf677d3bf7&_m=1984010bfe0342dea82f4829129df8be&_e=GGqsOlN696OUK6lcoexKcFjiy824WR3TZ3e173LC1X1JXZtWF2Z5IRcawr4CAU_M-TcqvLyCHou6zzhowL3ZKcWHxPAiHEHruXl9JAAIYbqq4rpJt9_ZC-3-kUM-ZN5t4R8Zh0TOcTTvH-UNlcXGgVtKI0OhK8pAjG9R4Qn6pA9TbD5Bp9bBUJLmgbvlbIgJdYR2n98RLcj2-iZ4y-QFBpk3aIhyzC_GSbOOmM5wUYu1f_PkPI4YHg1y4pfeCndNr7xzNEU7YcA8XhnHP6HMnoMLG6L3Zn5Xn62opx4L5Xd4WceEwz9xpd1U-f9Hu7h-358rIwCKaYDIzfzwaE3WJRaGUz8e99D0mp0ryTB9Oi9PPCsl7RQJ-drVqW_YW-ZRFKk1_ufsDPsC3iEVIEGb9JFHoD9hLfO_M_6NH4QaLYWJ6klWv0x2DJTEY538oOIssPJlYvZjWepWWgx2FRjHIHL9c0hAGYxYDpjqneA70Ui0-4IZeuIu5pET8YVaMSwIViMxScj8wiMnodXgaspzxw%3D%3D)
---

Here's the truth: The next generation should be allowed to grow up with the opportunity to know family values, to be proud of who they are, and not to be confused about basic biology.

****We must win the war against the Alphabet Mafia.****

body:
| | | |
---
| | | **Three Meaningful Ways to Support Veterans This Weekend**
---
| While Donald Trump rolls tanks down Pennsylvania Avenue to the tune of $40 million, the very veterans who once operated those machines are facing major funding cuts, seeing their lifesaving health care programs put at risk, and watching their financial assistance and mental health services slowly chipped away by Trump and Republicans.
---
|
---
| This weekend, Democrats are activating supporters to show up for veterans who are being left behind by the Trump Administration. Here’s how you can honor service with action. **1\. Support Organizations Doing the Work, like VoteVets** Because of the Trump administration’s chaotic funding cuts, the VA system is in crisis, and veterans’ health care access, housing programs, and benefits have all been put at risk. And MAGA Republicans are only making it worse as they continue to push to shrink essential services.

Organizations like VoteVets are fighting back. Through public campaigns, they amplify veterans’ voices on the issues that matter most, from health care access to national security. Your support helps them hold leaders accountable and ensure veterans get the care and dignity they deserve.
---
| [Learn More About VoteVets](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=3cbc23501e&e=d6c5c7d7ec "Learn More About VoteVets")
---
| **2\. Uplift Veterans in Your Own Community** Right in your community, there are veterans struggling with housing insecurity, job transitions, mental health, and access to care. While Republican leaders play politics with their lives, local organizations are filling in the gaps.
---
|
---
| Identify a local nonprofit that supports veterans. Whether it’s a shelter offering transitional housing, a legal clinic helping navigate VA claims, or a food bank running a special program for veterans, these groups are often under-resourced and overburdened. **Here are a few things you can do:**
* Volunteer for a shift or sign up to help at an upcoming event.
* Make a donation to cover urgent needs like transportation or hygiene kits.
* Ask how your workplace or community group can sponsor a project or drive.

**3\. Reach Out to a Veteran In Your Life.** Sometimes the most powerful action is a personal one. If there’s a veteran in your life like a family member, coworker, neighbor, or friend, take a few minutes to reach out. Ask how they’re doing. Let them know you care. **Veterans have earned their right to be heard.**

If they’ve been affected by recent cuts, encourage them to share their story with VoteVets’ tipline. [Submit a story to VoteVets’ Tipline here.](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=31687224f7&e=d6c5c7d7ec)
**Bonus: Spread the Word** We need more people to understand what’s really happening to our veterans in this country — and how Democrats are stepping up to fight back. **Share content on social media and in your networks to lift up the truth about Trump’s attacks on veterans and what Democrats are doing to protect them.**
